new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Manufacturing Engineering Programs
new_roles.description:
Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace.
 
 
**About The Role**
As a Senior Manager of MFG Engineering Programs in our New Product Introduction group, you will be responsible and accountable to lead and deliver global nuclear fuel manufacturing project execution across Westinghouse Electric Corporation (WEC) fuel manufacturing facilities in the US, UK & Sweden operations. You will be deployed to guide progress and execution of multiple projects within our organization, based on the program needs. The Sr Manager owns the global manufacturing scope of new product introduction and is accountable to lead project execution to delivery in-full, without complaint products to our customers while meeting safety and financial goals. This position will guide interaction between Fuel Engineering, Nuclear Fuel Project Managers, Product Delivery & Commercial Managers, Product Management, Supply Chain, SIOP, Plant Manufacturing Managers, Global Quality, and Supplier or customer teams. It will also coordinate on project deliverables, issues, and resolution. Program budget accountability ranges from $1M - $20M.
 
 
You will report to the Director of New Product Introduction and support the role remotely with 25 - 35% travel between global manufacturing facilities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Comprehend entire program scope, such as commercial, licensing, regulatory and initiate appropriate scope within the manufacturing program scope.
* Support project task-based schedules and track/report milestone progress against the program management plan.
* Deploy strategies for optimizing and streamlining legacy fuel manufacturing operations in partnership with manufacturing sites and functional leads.
* Analyze existing processes and identify value-added and non-value-added activities to solve design challenges.
* Manage project risks and opportunities to closure in partnership with functional leads and Program Managers. Identify issues, propose solutions and lead recovery plans to closure.
* Implement within project schedule and budget, tracking expenses and identifying cost-savings opportunities. Communicate with partners, providing updates on project milestones, risks, critical escalations and issues.
* Present strategic project reports, status updates, and performance metrics to senior leadership and important partners.
* Identify areas of improvement or gaps in current processes and develop strategies to promote efficiency and productivity in new product and process introduction.
* Perform as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to support project teams in new product and process development such as APQP and PPAP industry standards.
* Compare actual performance against planned performance to identify variances and help manage tasks on project planning.
* Collaborate with program team members and departments to establish plans and schedules that allocate resources to best achieve program requirements and service internal and external client or customer needs.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering.
* 10 -15 years related experience in Nuclear/ Automotive/ Heavy Engineering/ Metals Industry / Manufacturing / Assembly.
* Experience with project management and new product introduction into manufacturing.
* Analytical capabilities to identify critical schedule paths and improve engineering / supply chain timelines.
* Demonstrated skills in internal operational partner relationship management.
* Advance level PMI certification in Project Management.
* Experience of Engineering Component Manufacturing systems.
* Experience with engineering product development including design phases, manufacturing processes and global supply chain management.
* Familiarization with Kaizen, Lean Operations, FMEA's, DMAIC, DFMAs, POCA cycles.
* Familiarization with Microsoft Project, P6 or other scheduling software.

We are committed to transparency and equity in all of our people practices. The base salary range for this position, which is dependent upon experience, qualifications and skills, is estimated to be $144,000 to $180,000 per year.
 
 
**Why Westinghouse?**
**Benefits**
**Our benefits package is tailored to meet the diverse needs of our employees, while also promoting wellness and career growth. The following are representative of what we offer:**

* Comprehensive Medical benefits which could include medical, dental, vision, prescription coverage and Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions options
* Wellness Programs designed to support employees in maintaining their health and well-being including Employee Assistance Program providing support for our employees and their household members
* 401(k) with Company Match Contributions to support employees' retirement
* Paid Vacations and Company Holidays
* Opportunities for Flexible Work Arrangements to promote work-life balance
* Educational Reimbursement and Comprehensive Career Programs to help employees grow in their careers
* Global Recognition and Service Programs to celebrate employee accomplishments and service
* Employee Referral Program

Westinghouse Electric Company Is The Global Nuclear Energy Industry's First Choice For Safe, Clean, And Efficient Energy Solutions. We Enable Our Delivery Of This Vision By Living Our Value System
 
 

* Safety and Quality
* Integrity and Trust
* Customer Focus and Innovation
* Speed and Passion to Win
* Teamwork and Accountability

**While our Global Headquarters are located in Cranberry Township, PA, we have over 11,000 employees working at locations in 19 different countries. You can learn more by visiting**
http://www.westinghousenuclear.com .
 
 
Westinghouse is an Equal Opportunity Employer including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities
 
 
**Get connected with Westinghouse on social media:**
**Twitter**
**|**
**Facebook**
**|**
**LinkedIn |**
**YouTube**

new_roles.description:
**About us:**
At Plexus, our vision is to help create the products that build a better world. Driven by a passion for excellence, we partner with leading Aerospace/Defense, Healthcare/Life Sciences and Industrial companies to design, manufacture and service some of the world’s most transformative products, including advanced surgical systems, diagnostic instruments, healthcare imaging equipment, mission critical aerospace systems, and electric vehicle (EV) charging solutions. Visit Plexus.com to learn more about our unwavering commitment to our vision.
 
 
**When we invest in our people, we invest in building a better world.**
With a vision rooted in the wellbeing and inclusive engagement of our team members, our customers, their end users and our communities, people are the heart of what we do and who we are. It is our values that unite us and guide us in everything that we do, including how we operate, behave and interact to foster a workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best.
 
 
Our values include: Growing our People, Building Belonging, Innovating Responsibly, Delivering Excellence and Creating Customer Success.
 
 
As a team member, you will engage in impactful work through global collaboration and the use of emerging technologies, join an inclusive culture where every team member is valued and working toward a greater purpose, and be empowered to reach your full potential through various development programs designed to accelerate your growth.
 
 
Plexus offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support team members' wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid time off, retirement savings, and opportunities for professional development. We also prioritize work-life balance and offer a variety of perks to enhance the team member experience. For more information, visit our US benefits website at usbenefits.plexus.com. Our commitment to pay range transparency fosters an equitable workplace, where everyone can feel valued. The annual compensation range for this position is stated below. The salary offered within this range will be based upon the geographic location, work experience, education, licensure requirements and/or skill level. Salary Range:
 
 
$132,500.00 - $198,700.00
 
 
**Purpose Statement:**
To provide leadership and direction to the Manufacturing Engineering team(s) from a functional perspective. Manage the Manufacturing Engineering function in line with functional specific strategies, process and systems development, people development, employee relations, plant level metrics.
 
 
**Key Job Accountabilities**

* Lead manufacturing-engineering excellence by collaborating with various functional leads to ensure engineering capability meets or exceeds manufacturing standards for quality product delivery.
* Support Program Management initiatives and activities to meet or exceed customer expectations.
* Lead process/product/equipment engineering activities in compliance with Plexus Core Values to meet industry standards, regulatory and customer requirements.
* Provide technical leadership to site operations, establish a technology roadmap, and collaborate with corporate and regional technical teams to achieve lower costs and higher manufacturing returns.
* Responsible to exemplify and hold their team accountable to demonstrating the Plexus Core Values. Leader will focus on evaluating potential, driving succession planning, and ensuring their employees receive the development and coaching required to realize their full potential.

**Education/Experience Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree with 8 or more years of related experience is preferred. An equivalent combination of education and/or experience will be considered.
* Proven leadership skills and management experience.

new_roles.title: Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer, General Assembly & Test, Optimus
new_roles.description:
**What To Expect**
Tesla is seeking a highly motivated Sr. Staff Manufacturing Engineer to build and lead a team of engineers focused on high-volume production launches. This role will drive the development of scalable manufacturing systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to optimize product designs for manufacturability, accelerate assembly processes, and implement automation solutions. In this fast-paced, demanding environment, you’ll play a pivotal role in scaling Tesla’s SI robotics initiatives while advancing our mission to achieve sustainable abundance through innovative manufacturing practices.
 
 
**What You'll Do**- Lead Manufacturing Engineering Team: Build, mentor, and scale high-performing teams to design and deploy high-volume production systems, ensuring alignment with Tesla’s speed and quality objectives
- Collaborate with Equipment Suppliers: Partner with internal and external suppliers to engineer, install, and validate production equipment, accelerating line ramp-up to meet volume targets
- Validate Requirements and Constraints: Use first principles analysis to rigorously assess product and process requirements, eliminating ambiguity and ensuring all elements are purpose-driven and essential
- Optimize Production Processes: Identify and remove non-value-added steps in workflows, prioritizing functional simplicity before pursuing automation or advanced optimization
- Improve Cycle Time: Analyze production bottlenecks and implement solutions to increase process speed, throughput, and overall line efficiency
- Deploy Automation Solutions: Strategically integrate automation as a final step after process simplification, ensuring systems are robust, high-speed, and scalable
- Ensure Seamless Operational Transitions: Coordinate with operations teams during ramp-up phases, delivering detailed documentation and training to sustain engineering teams for long-term success
**What You'll Bring**- First Principles Thinking: A rigorous mindset focused on breaking down complex problems to their fundamental truths, enabling innovative solutions to manufacturing challenges
- Proficiency in CAD tools (Catia and AutoCAD preferred) for designing and optimizing production systems
- Deep knowledge of mechanical assembly techniques (pressing, fastening, harnessing, etc.) and electrical integration, including quality control matrices, testing protocols, and troubleshooting methodologies
- Familiarity with torque tools, automation equipment, control systems, and communication protocols (e.g., PLC, HMI, SCADA)
- Production Transition Experience: Demonstrated success in scaling products from prototype to high-volume production, ensuring seamless handover to sustaining teams
- Resilience & Adaptability: Ability to thrive in high-pressure environments while managing competing priorities and tight deadlines
- Communication & Organization: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, paired with meticulous attention to detail and a highly organized approach to documentation and process handover
- Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical or Electrical engineering, or equivalent experience
**Benefits**
Along with competitive pay, as a full-time Tesla employee, you are eligible for the following benefits at day 1 of hire:
 
- Medical plans > plan options with $0 payroll deduction
- Family-building, fertility, adoption and surrogacy benefits
- Dental (including orthodontic coverage) and vision plans, both have options with a $0 paycheck contribution
- Company Paid (Health Savings Accounts) HSA Contribution when enrolled in the High-Deductible medical plan with HSA
- Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
- 401(k) with employer match, Employee Stock Purchase Plans, and other financial benefits
- Company paid Basic Life, AD&D
- Short-term and long-term disability insurance (90 day waiting period)
- Employee Assistance Program
- Sick and Vacation time (Flex time for salary positions, Accrued hours for Hourly positions), and Paid Holidays
- Back-up childcare and parenting support resources
- Voluntary benefits to include: critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, theft & legal services, and pet insurance
- Weight Loss and Tobacco Cessation Programs
- Tesla Babies program
- Commuter benefits
- Employee discounts and perks program
- Earned Wage Access: Real-time pay access paid daily, subject to eligibility and schedule (applicable for below Sr. Managers levels)
Expected Compensation
 
 
$156,000 - $276,000/annual salary + cash and stock awards + benefits
 
 
Pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including market location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements dependent on the position offered. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment.
 
 
, Tesla

new_roles.title: Director, New Product Development Engineering
new_roles.description:
Bevi is on a mission to transform how beverages are delivered and consumed. Our connected beverage platform eliminates the need for single-use bottles and cans, making it easy, fun, and sustainable to stay hydrated. As the category leader in IoT-enabled beverage technology, we're building a future where Bevi machines are everywhere people live, work, and connect. We've raised over $160M in venture capital, serve thousands of customers across the US, Canada, UK and Ireland, and we've been rapidly growing year over year, saving over 1 billion bottles from waste. In addition to driving hypergrowth with our current product line, Bevi is heavily investing in new product development.
 
 
Bevi is hiring a Director of New Product Development Engineering to lead the team that designs our next generation of beverage machines and takes them into high-volume production. The work spans new platforms, smaller form-factor machines, hot water, flavor cartridges, and consumables, and brings together hardware, software, and beverage science.
 
 
Your top priority is scaling. You'll take Bevi's hardware into much higher-volume, lower-cost manufacturing, working closely with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners. You'll lead NPD Engineering, Systems Engineering, and Compliance Engineering, and own new products from concept through certification and production launch.
 
 
This role reports to the VP of Engineering, sits on the engineering leadership team, and works across Product, Software, Quality, Supply Chain, Operations, and more. Bevi is still growing fast, so you'll have real room to shape how we build hardware and the team that does it. Expect regular travel to manufacturing partners in Asia.
 
 
What You'll Own
 
 
New Product Development
 
 

* Lead new product programs from concept and prototype through EVT, DVT, PVT, and mass production.
* Own product architecture and make the tradeoff calls on cost, reliability, manufacturability, and schedule, while staying hands-on in design reviews and critical build issues.
* Set cost targets (BOM, tooling, landed cost) early and design to them, with DFM, DFA, and design-for-cost built in from the start.

High-Volume Manufacturing & Working with ODMs
 
 

* Lead Bevi's shift to high-volume, lower-cost manufacturing with ODM, JDM, and overseas contract manufacturing partners.
* Work with partner engineering teams as true collaborators: align on specs, work through design feedback together, and decide where their expertise can speed up our programs.
* Drive NPI and transfer to production, including pilot builds, line validation, and yield ramp, with time on-site during critical builds.

Systems Engineering & Compliance
 
 

* Guide Systems Engineering on requirements, architecture, DFMEA, and design verification across mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and beverage subsystems.
* Oversee product safety and regulatory certification (UL, NSF, FCC, CE/UKCA, and food-contact requirements) so it supports international growth and stays off the critical path.

Team Leadership & Process
 
 

* Lead and grow a team of NPD, Systems, and Compliance engineers, including managers, aligned to one product roadmap.
* Recruit and develop engineering talent to build an organization that scales with Bevi's product strategy.
* Run a clear product development process, with phase gates and design reviews, that works for both in-house and partner-led programs.
* Champion the use of AI across the team to speed up design, analysis, testing, and documentation.

What We're Looking For
 
 

* 12+ years in hardware product development, including 5+ years leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams that include managers.
* Ability to be in the office 3+ days per week.
* Ability to travel up to 25%, including extended trips to overseas manufacturing partners.
* A track record of scaling electromechanical products into high-volume production (tens of thousands of units or more), ideally in consumer electronics, appliances, or connected devices.
* Hands-on experience partnering with ODMs and overseas contract manufacturers (Asia strongly preferred), from spec through design iterations, NPI, tooling, and yield ramp, including time on the ground with them.
* Strong design-for-cost and DFM/DFA skills, with a record of driving down BOM and landed cost at volume.
* Knowledge of high-volume manufacturing processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, die casting, and automated assembly.
* Experience with systems engineering practices and bringing products through safety and regulatory certification.
* A practical, hands-on approach to using AI tools in engineering work.
* A strong communicator who is credible in a design review, on a factory floor, and in a leadership meeting.
* BS in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. Experience with fluid, thermal, or food and beverage systems is a plus.

new_roles.title: Director of Product Development & Industrialization
new_roles.description:
At Horizon Hobby, we inspire dreams and help build memories! Our company is the leader in the global Radio Control industry, celebrating 40 years in 2025! We offer tremendous opportunities for growth and development and a full array of benefits including discounts on our products! We are currently hiring for a Director of Product Development and Industrialization at our Pro-Line office in Banning CA!
 
 
*This is a full time, on-site position at our Pro-Line facility in Banning California. Workings hours will be Monday-Friday 8am-5pm PST.*
**Typical pay for this position is $105,000-$125,000. The final offer for this position will be based on the unique experience and qualifications of the candidate selected. This position may also be eligible for a bonus not included in the base pay range.**
The Director of Product Development & Industrialization will provide strategic leadership for the development, commercialization, and industrialization of proprietary hobby products from concept through production. This role will be leading our Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization resources while overseeing the systems, processes, tooling, molds, manufacturing equipment, and technical capabilities required to deliver innovative, high-quality products to market.
 
 
This role will partner closely with Brand, Sales, Marketing, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Tooling, and external partners to identify market opportunities, translate customer needs into successful products, and ensure products are designed, developed, and launched efficiently. The role balances technical excellence with business performance, ensuring product investments align with growth objectives, customer demand, profitability targets, and long-term strategic priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
Product Innovation & Strategy
 
 

* Partner with Brand and cross-functional teams to define product roadmaps, priorities, resources, and timelines.
* Drive innovation and development investments that strengthen market position, customer satisfaction, growth, and return on investment.
* Identify and prioritize new product opportunities using customer insight, competitive analysis, market trends, and commercial potential.

Product Development Leadership
 
 

* Lead and develop Product Development, Product Engineering, and Industrialization teams supporting proprietary products.
* Own product development from concept and engineering through validation, launch, and lifecycle management.
* Strengthen quality, scalability, execution, and organizational capability through standards, coaching, succession planning, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Business & Commercial Leadership
 
 

* Monitor portfolio performance and align cross-functional priorities to achieve revenue, profitability, and strategic objectives.
* Contribute to portfolio planning, market expansion, long-range growth, budgeting, forecasting, and resource allocation.
* Provide senior leadership with business reviews, development updates, performance metrics, and recommendations.

Industrialization & Manufacturing Readiness
 
 

* Lead new-product industrialization from concept through launch, applying DFM and DFA to optimize quality, scalability, cost, and manufacturing readiness.
* Partner across Engineering, Manufacturing, Tool Room, suppliers, and development teams to resolve challenges and improve processes, tooling, and capacity.
* Track launch, readiness, quality, and productivity performance to drive continuous improvement.

Tooling, Equipment & Technology
 
 

* Define requirements and roadmaps for molds, tooling, fixtures, machinery, automation, and manufacturing technology.
* Lead capital planning and business cases that improve capability, productivity, quality, cost, and return on investment.
* Manage external tooling and manufacturing partners, strengthen internal capabilities, and maintain effective engineering data and technical documentation processes.

Supplier & Partner Management
 
 

* Build strategic relationships with domestic and international manufacturing, tooling, engineering, and supplier partners.
* Evaluate supplier capabilities and performance to improve quality, speed, cost competitiveness, and alignment with business objectives.

*Success in this role requires strong leadership across innovation, engineering, manufacturing, and business functions to continuously improve speed to market, product quality, operational performance, and return on investment*
**Required**
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in product management, category management, business management, product development, or a related leadership role.
* 5+ years of experience leading and developing teams.
* Demonstrated success growing a product category, business unit, or consumer product portfolio.
* Experience developing and launching successful products from concept through commercialization.
* Strong financial acumen with experience managing budgets, forecasting, business cases, and profitability.
* Proven ability to develop business strategies and translate them into measurable results.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities.
* Ability to travel as required for customer visits, product testing, trade shows, industry events, and supplier meetings.

**Preferred**

* Experience in the RC, hobby products, powersports, automotive aftermarket, consumer products, or related industries.
* Experience working directly with enthusiast communities, racers, influencers, or brand ambassadors.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, new product introduction, and global sourcing environments.
* Experience using product lifecycle management (PLM) and project management systems.

**Physical Requirements**

* Occasional lifting of office supplies and materials, up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to sit or stand for extended periods while working on a computer.

*The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.*
**Benefits & Other Perks**

* Medical, Dental, Vision
* HSA and FSA options
* Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance
* Life Insurance and Supplemental Life Insurance
* 401(k) with a company match
* Paid Time Off
* Paid Holidays
* Internal Rewards
* Discounts on Products
* Additional Coverage such as accident, critical, hospital and pet insurance

*Horizon Hobby is a progressive, innovative company and, as such, is constantly reevaluating and reinventing the processes and procedures associated with each job. The essential duties and responsibilities of this position may change at any time. In addition, employees may be asked to work on special projects or to assist with other work necessary or important to the operation of Horizon. Your cooperation and assistance in performing such additional work is expected and appreciated.*
**Horizon Hobby, LLC is an equal opportunity and E-Verify employer**

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 122,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.
 
 
**Director, Operational Excellence**
We're advancing cancer care through innovative screening and diagnostic tests that help patients and healthcare providers make informed decisions before, during and after a cancer diagnosis. Our growing portfolio includes Cologuard®, Oncotype DX®, Cancerguard® and Oncodetect®, along with advanced genetic testing, supporting patients from cancer prevention and early detection through personalized treatment decisions and recurrence monitoring. We're focused on helping more people take action against cancer at its earliest, most treatable stages, so they can live longer, healthier lives.
 
 
This role is based on-site in Madison, WI.
 
 
**Position Overview**
Abbott is seeking a Director, Operational Excellence to lead the development, implementation, and sustainability of operational excellence practices across our Cancer Diagnostics operations.
 
 
This leader will partner closely with operations leadership and frontline teams to strengthen daily management practices, improve operational performance, and build a culture of continuous improvement and accountability.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities :**

* Lead the implementation of operational excellence practices that improve safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance.
* Establish and sustain tiered management routines, visual performance boards, standardized metrics, and structured performance reviews across hourly, daily, weekly, and monthly intervals.
* Partner with operations leaders to implement supervisor standard work, strengthen accountability, and develop consistent problem-solving and performance management practices.
* Apply Lean and Six Sigma methodologies to improve process flow, eliminate waste, reduce variation, and drive measurable operational results.
* Establish employee-driven improvement programs that encourage frontline participation, idea generation, and ownership of operational improvements.
* Lead change management efforts that ensure new processes are adopted, embedded into daily operations, and sustained over time.
* Collaborate with Operations, Quality, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to align improvement initiatives with business priorities.
* Lead and coach a team of operational excellence professionals while building continuous improvement capabilities across the broader organization.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science, Operations Management, Business, Supply Chain, or a related field with a minimum of 10 years of relevant experience; or Master's degree in a related field with a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience.
* Significant progressive experience in operations leadership, operational excellence, or continuous improvement within a manufacturing, laboratory, or complex operational environment.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and sustaining Lean practices, daily management systems, visual performance management, and structured problem-solving.
* Experience leading operational teams or working directly with frontline leaders to drive measurable performance improvements.
* Proven ability to lead organizational change, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and build accountability.
* Strong people leadership, coaching, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct leadership experience in manufacturing, laboratory, or other high-volume operations.
* Experience in regulated industries such as diagnostics, medical devices, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certification or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience implementing tiered management systems, supervisor standard work, and employee-driven continuous improvement programs.
* Demonstrated success sustaining operational improvements through frontline engagement and leadership ownership.

The base pay for this position is $149,300.00 – $298,700.00. In specific locations, the pay range may vary from the range posted.

new_roles.title: Director - Corporate Continuous Improvement
new_roles.description:
**Description**
****Position Summary****
The Director of Corporate Continuous Improvement (CI) leads MacAllister’s enterprise CI strategy, Corporate CI team, and improvement portfolio. In partnership with the owner, executive team, and divisional leaders, the Director helps establish and build alignment around MacAllister’s CI vision, strategy, priorities, and multi-year roadmap. The Director identifies and prioritizes high-value opportunities, builds organizational problem-solving capability, and leads improvement work from opportunity identification through execution and sustainment.
 
 
The role establishes CI standards, tools, and training; coaches, mentors, and influences leaders and teams across the organization; and communicates CI priorities, results, and opportunities for support.
 
 
The ultimate objective is to build and sustain a culture in which continuous improvement becomes habitual and is reflected in how leaders and employees think, act, solve problems, and improve the way work gets done.
 
 
****Position Duties/Responsibilities****
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Partner with the executive team, and divisional leaders to develop and maintain MacAllister’s CI strategy, multi-year roadmap, priorities, and operating model aligned with company goals. Build leadership alignment and shared ownership of CI priorities and expectations across the organization.
* Own CI project identification, prioritization, approval, execution, and close-out, focusing on where CI creates the most value; support employee-driven improvement alongside leader-sponsored initiatives.
* Maintain consistent project close-out documenting results, lessons learned, and sustainment plans; verify improvements and results are sustained and take corrective action as needed.
* Set organization-wide CI standards, tools, and terminology; guide Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA application grounded in facts, data, and root cause analysis; coach project teams and facilitate select high-impact improvement events.
* Lead improvement-related change management, engaging affected employees early and ensuring process adoption and sustainment.
* Oversee CI training tailored to responsibility levels using consistent terminology and live projects; coach and support CI-trained departmental leaders who remain in their home departments outside CI.
* Define CI value primarily through capability measures—leaders solving problems independently, AI use cases adopted, and idea-to-approval cycle time—with financial results as supporting evidence.
* Communicate CI initiatives, results, and available support so leaders know when and how to engage the team; share success stories and recognize improvement contributors.
* Use coaching-first leadership to build team autonomy, confidence, and influence; foster problem reporting, experimentation, and learning from mistakes by supporting people publicly and coaching privately.
* Hire, develop, and manage CI personnel; oversee budget, resource allocation, and team structure as needs evolve.
* Play a leadership role in MacAllister’s Center of Practice for CI, AI, and problem-solving leadership, incorporating AI and other emerging technologies into CI methods where they improve problem solving, decision making, or productivity. Partner with MacAllister’s enterprise AI leadership on broader AI strategy, standards, and adoption.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Directly supervises the Corporate CI team and oversees day-to-day operations of the CI department. Mentors and coaches CI team members to strengthen their capabilities as problem solvers, facilitators, coaches, and trusted business partners.
* Reviews and evaluates the work and performance of reporting employees; has authority for hiring and disciplinary actions.

****Position Requirements****
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, or a related field.
* 10 years or more of experience in continuous improvement, operations, or business transformation.
* 5 years or more of experience leading leaders.
* Proven success coaching others to identify and solve problems independently.
* Working knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, DMAIC, and PDCA.
* A valid driver’s license.

**Preferred**

* Master’s degree in business or a related discipline.
* Lean Six Sigma Master Black Belt or equivalent depth of experience designing and delivering CI training.
* Experience at a Caterpillar dealership or in the equipment sales, service, or rental industry.
* Demonstrated curiosity and willingness to learn and apply emerging technologies, including AI, to strengthen problem solving, process improvement, decision support, and organizational productivity. Experience applying AI in these areas is preferred but not required.
* Experience building on an existing CI function and growing its influence across a multi-location organization.

****Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities****

* Strong coaching and leadership development skills; leads through influence rather than authority.
* Ability to connect improvement work to business priorities and help leaders choose where to focus.
* Curiosity about and practical comfort with AI as a business tool.
* Exceptional communication and facilitation skills with all levels, from the front line to executives.
* Ability to build and maintain trusted relationships with executives, senior managers, and teams.
* Respect for existing culture and relationships, with the judgment to improve without unnecessary disruption.
* Strong organizational, prioritization, and project management skills.
* Effective computer skills with Microsoft Office and the ability to learn proprietary systems.

****Other Requirements of Position****

* Works under broad supervision. Designs and carries out programs and far-reaching objectives independently, informing management as appropriate.
* Major responsibilities require a wide degree of creativity and latitude.
* If an error is made while in this position, it will require some effort to identify and can significantly impact the company financially.
* Frequently communicates with coworkers, customers, company executives, and management.
* Maintain equipment and supplies to avoid waste, damage to areas and equipment, and to prevent accidents.

The duties and responsibilities outlined in this posting are not exhaustive and may evolve based on business needs.
 
 
All MacAllister Machinery companies are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer, including Disabled and Veteran applicants.

new_roles.title: Director, Central Quality Audit, Pharmacovigilance
new_roles.description:
**Job Description Summary**
===========================

Managing, ensuring and improving capabilities to comply with external standards and regulations. Interprets internal and external business challenges and recommends best practices to improve products, processes or services. Stays informed of industry trends that may influence work. 
 
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

**Job Description**
===================

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Own the Pharmacovigilance (PV) Audit Program: Develop, implement, and maintain the global PV audit strategy, ensuring alignment with regulatory expectations (e.g., EMA, FDA, MHRA, PMDA) and industry best practices.
* Manage Audit Operations: Oversee scheduling, planning, execution, reporting, and follow-up for PV audits, including internal audits and audits of service providers and affiliates. Fully participate in the audit program; actively owning and executing PV audits.
* Risk Identification and Communication: Identify high-risk compliance issues, escalate findings, and provide actionable recommendations to senior leadership.
* Regulatory Inspection Support: Prepare for and support PV-related health authority inspections, including back-room management and post-inspection follow-up.
* Metrics and Reporting: Define and track PV audit KPIs, ensuring visibility of compliance risks and trends to leadership.
* System Ownership: Manage audit-related modules within the electronic Quality Management System (eQMS), including support of configuration, UAT, and documentation.
* Team Leadership: Lead and develop a team of 3–5 auditors, providing coaching, mentorship, and performance management.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with PV Operations, Quality, and Regulatory teams to ensure audit outcomes drive continuous improvement.
* Strategic Influence: Contribute to policy development and influence PV compliance strategy across the organization.

**Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.
* Qualified Lead Auditor with active certification.
* Master’s degree and 5+ years in pharmacovigilance or pharmaceutical industry; or Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years relevant experience.
* Minimum of 5 years’ experience driving Global programs to resolve quality compliance issues (directly).
* Experience with Pharmaceutical QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to cGMP, GDP, GPvP, GCP and GLP.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Experience with Medical Device QMS requirements and regulatory requirements including but not limited to FDA CFR 21 820 and ISO 13485.
* Prior Veeva and TrackWise Digital experience a plus.
* Prior health authority experience a plus.
* IRCA, ASQ (CQE, CQA, etc.) and/or Lean Certification a plus (green belt, black belt).
* Extensive experience in the Medica Device and Pharmaceutical industry.
* Understanding of product quality improvement using tools such as Six Sigma, DFR.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems.
* Exceptional conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to interface with top organizational leadership and internal and external customers, responding in a professional manner.
* Demonstrated ability to lead programs / projects. Ability to prioritize and drive multiple programs.
* Ability to energize others by building a connection with the team through personal involvement and trust, providing feedback and coaching to develop others, and accountability of actions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills in English.
* Integrity: Accepting and adhering to high ethical, moral, and personal values in decisions, communications, actions, and when dealing with others.
* Ability to travel globally up to 15%.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership –always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support.

We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. For U.S. based positions only, the pay range for this position is $142,400.00-$213,600.00 Annual. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the pay range and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. The specific compensation offered to a candidate may be influenced by a variety of factors including skills, qualifications, experience and location. In addition, this position may also be eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). GE HealthCare offers a competitive benefits package, including not but limited to medical, dental, vision, paid time off, a 401(k) plan with employee and company contribution opportunities, life, disability, and accident insurance, and tuition reimbursement.

**Additional Information**
==========================

GE HealthCare offers a great work environment, professional development, challenging careers, and competitive compensation. GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

GE HealthCare will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States for this opening. Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen (as applicable).

While GE HealthCare does not currently require U.S. employees to be vaccinated against COVID-19, some GE HealthCare customers have vaccination mandates that may apply to certain GE HealthCare employees.

**Relocation Assistance Provided:** No

Application Deadline: December 21, 2026

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**About the Role:**

As Director of Quality, you’ll lead Helix’s quality department and drive the development of systems, practices, and people to ensure product excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer satisfaction. You’ll hire, train, and manage the team, own the quality system, and make it clear who is responsible for quality at every step.

You’ll report directly to the Chief Executive Officer, partner closely with Engineering, Operations, and our customers to build a proactive, scalable, and right-sized quality system that enables growth.

### **Key Responsibilities:**

**Strategic Leadership & Systems Development**

* Develop and continuously improve a scalable Quality Management System aligned with AS9100 and customer requirements
* Lead departmental strategy, structure, and capital planning to support business growth
* Serve as ISO/AS Management Representative

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Lead and mentor a team of 5+ quality engineers, inspectors, and technicians
* Develop people and build team capabilities in metrology, inspection, and quality engineering
* Foster a culture of collaboration and real-time problem-solving on the shop floor

**Customer & Compliance Management**

* Lead customer and supplier audits; own response and resolution of corrective actions
* Ensure documentation, compliance, and audit readiness
* Build trusted relationships with key customers and act as the face of Quality

**Quality Engineering & Continuous Improvement**

* Partner with operators to implement in-process quality at the machine (not just post-process inspection)
* Drive root cause analysis, SPC implementation, and corrective actions to reduce scrap and improve first-pass yield
* Support new product introductions and ensure proper gauges, fixtures, and inspection plans are in place

**Internal Inspection & Production Support**

* Oversee first-piece, in-process, and final inspection plans
* Continuously simplify and optimize inspection methods to reduce bottlenecks without sacrificing quality

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Promoting Operational Excellence by initiating and helping implement continuous improvement objectives.
* Maintaining a robust QMS system and compliance to AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards.
* Leading the company during customer audits and independent audits towards successful (re)certification.
* Lowering scrap and increasing first pass yield.
* Cross functional collaboration with Production and Engineering to help build quality into the process.
* Implementing solid Corrective Actions to reduce RMAs and DMRs.
* Establishing best practices for the Quality department and the organization as a whole

### **Who You Are**

* A pragmatic quality leader who blends systems thinking with real-world shop floor experience
* Confident navigating between big-picture strategy and hands-on process improvement
* A builder of systems and people, able to lead a team and train on complex equipment
* Comfortable in a customer-facing role and able to communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Committed to continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivering value across departments

### **Qualifications:**

**Must-Haves**

* 10+ years in manufacturing quality, preferably in machining-based environments
* Strong knowledge of AS9100 and ISO 9001 standards
* Experience leading customer and regulatory audits
* Proven people management skills
* Working knowledge of metrology, CMM, GD&T, and SPC tools
* Experience balancing compliance with operational efficiency

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Mechanical or technical degree
* Experience supporting New Product Development (NPD)
* Six Sigma, Lean, or ASQ certifications (CQE, CQA, CQM)
* Familiarity with vision systems, statistical software (e.g., Minitab), and automation of inspection processes

**About the Company:**

Helix Linear Technologies designs and manufactures high-precision motion control systems for industries where performance matters most, like aerospace, medical devices, and industrial automation. We’re in a phase of strategic growth, investing in R&D, advanced equipment, and new product lines, including aerospace-grade ball screws.

Our clean, climate-controlled facility is built for precision, focus, and continuous improvement. At Helix, you’ll join a team that values ownership, technical excellence, and curiosity.

new_roles.title: Director, Health Access & Quality Operations
new_roles.description:
The American Diabetes Association (ADA) is committed to expanding access to care, advancing health access, improving quality, and achieving better health outcomes for people living with diabetes, prediabetes, and obesity. The Director, Health Access & Quality Operations provides operational and financial oversight for the Health Access & Quality Department, ensuring effective planning, resource management, project execution, and performance accountability. Working closely with department leadership, Finance, Enterprise Strategy, the Program Management Office (PMO), and other internal stakeholders, this position translates departmental priorities into actionable plans, financial analyses, performance dashboards, and executive-level reporting.

 

The Director brings strong expertise in project and portfolio management, financial planning and analysis, dashboard development, and executive communications. The individual must demonstrate the ability to engage directly with Finance leaders on budgeting, forecasting, revenue and expense projections, financial variances, and resource allocation. Equally important is the ability to synthesize complex financial and operational information into meaningful insights, recommendations, and compelling presentations for executive leadership and Board-level audiences.

 

**Responsibilities** 
***Financial Planning & Analysis***

* Lead annual budget development and ongoing forecasting with Finance, including revenue and expense projections, reforecasts and scenario modeling.
* Prepare monthly budget-to-actual reports, analyze variances and recommend corrective actions.
* Track restricted and unrestricted funding, including grants, sponsorships and contracts, to ensure spending is compliant and aligned with funding requirements.
* Develop cost models, cost-benefit analyses and ROI assessments for new initiatives and investments.

 

***Project & Portfolio Management***

* Oversee the department's project portfolio, aligning priorities, resources, timelines and budgets with strategic goals.
* Develop project plans, timelines, risk logs and status reports, and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver on scope, schedule and budget.
* Partner with the PMO on governance, intake, prioritization and capacity planning.
* Monitor project budgets and burn rates, flagging risks early and proposing ways to reduce them.

 

***Performance Reporting & Executive Communications***

* Build and maintain executive dashboards and KPI scorecards that combine financial, operational and programmatic data.
* Prepare executive presentations, Board materials and management reports that explain complex information clearly.
* Present financial results, forecasts and project status to senior leadership to support decision-making.
* Show how financial investment connects to program outcomes and measurable impact.

 

***Operations & Process Improvement***

* Translate strategic priorities into operating plans with clear owners, timelines and success measures.
* Manage resource allocation, vendor contracts and spending controls in line with ADA policies.
* Identify inefficiencies and lead process improvements that produce measurable results.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to department leadership on financial, operational and project matters.

 

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Project Management, Operations, or a related field required.
* Formal finance education or training required, demonstrated through a degree, formal coursework, professional certification, or recognized financial management/financial planning and analysis training.
* Formal project management education or training required, demonstrated through a Project Management Professional (PMP) certification, Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM) certification, or completion of a recognized project management training program.
* Equivalent combinations of education, professional training, and relevant experience may be considered, provided formal training in both finance and project management is demonstrated.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive experience in business operations, financial planning and analysis, project or portfolio management, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex projects, developing project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams, and monitoring deliverables and outcomes.
* Substantial experience working directly with Finance leaders or Finance business partners on annual budgeting, revenue and expense forecasting, budget-to-actual analysis, variance reporting, and financial projections.
* Demonstrated ability to interpret financial statements, analyze financial performance, identify trends and variances, and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Experience developing and maintaining executive dashboards, KPI scorecards, financial reports, and performance management tools.
* Demonstrated ability to integrate financial, operational, and programmatic data to communicate organizational performance and measurable impact.
* Experience developing executive-level presentations, Board materials, and management reports that communicate complex information clearly and effectively.
* Demonstrated experience engaging senior executives and presenting financial, operational, and performance information to leadership audiences.
* Experience managing multiple projects, priorities, and stakeholders within a complex, matrixed organization.
* Experience identifying operational inefficiencies and implementing process improvements that produce measurable results.

 

***Preferred Qualifications***

* Advanced project management certification or additional specialized training in portfolio management, program management, or business process improvement.
* Experience in nonprofit, healthcare, public health, or mission-driven organizations.
* Experience managing financial performance across multiple programs, funding sources, grants, or geographic markets.
* Familiarity with financial planning and analysis (FP&A), enterprise resource planning (ERP) systems, and business intelligence platforms.
* Experience with Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, or comparable dashboard and project management platforms.
* Experience supporting executive leadership teams and preparing materials for Boards of Directors, Finance Committees, or other governance bodies.

 

**Why Work Here** 
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) offers a rewarding career working for one of the premier voluntary health organizations in the world supporting people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Our employees consistently say that our mission, culture, work-life balance, and total rewards package are what they like most about working at the ADA. benefits and our culture:

* Industry competitive base pay. Base offers are determined by several factors including but not limited to your relevant work experience, education, certifications, location, internal pay equity, etc.
* A culture of recognition including new hire welcome announcements, service anniversary awards, referral bonuses, monthly All Employee Assembly, appreciation awards
* Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays, vacation days, personal days and sick days
* Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), disability & life insurance, pet insurance, and retirement savings
* Guided by our mission, we provide full diabetes supply coverage through our medical benefits program
* A company focus on offering mental health programs and work/life balance with most of our employees working remote
* Joining our dedicated team affords the gratification of knowing beyond a doubt that you will impact the lives and well-being of millions

 

**About the Organization** 
The American Diabetes Association ® (ADA) is the nation’s leading voluntary health organization fighting to end diabetes and helping people living with diabetes thrive. Since 1940, we have driven discovery and research to prevent, manage, treat, and ultimately cure diabetes. We advocate for policy changes and improved access to quality care for all people living with diabetes and/or obesity. Through the Obesity Association, a division of the ADA, we are also working to reduce the prevalence of obesity—a leading risk factor for type 2 diabetes.

new_roles.title: Corporate Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
Take the next step with an exciting and growing company
 
As the only fully integrated maker of premium quality wire, rope, and assemblies, Loos & Co holds a leading position in the global aerospace sector.
 
A division of the Central Wire (CWI) Group of Companies encompassing 12 locations in three countries, 750+ employees, and over six decades of excellence, Loos & Co solutions are found in mission critical flight control applications. Our precision-manufactured components are also used for defense, med tech, and heavy industry purposes around the world, in large part because of the people behind our products.
 
Do you have a strong work ethic? Take pride in a job well done? Are you passionate about contributing to individual and team, company and customer successes? If you’re interested in joining a dynamic work environment that offers opportunities to reach your full potential, we want to hear from you.
 
 
Position Summary / Essential Function
 
The Corporate Director of Quality is CWI’s senior enterprise Quality leader and is responsible for establishing and sustaining a culture of quality excellence, accountability, customer focus, product safety, and continuous improvement across aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities. Based in Pomfret Center, Connecticut and reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the Director leads the enterprise Quality function, develops high-performing teams of Quality professionals, and establishes the governance, systems, standards, metrics, and decision rights required for consistent execution across all locations.
 
A central responsibility of the role is to create a results- and data-driven culture in which decisions are based on objective evidence, process capability, customer and regulatory requirements, risk, and measurable business outcomes. The Director advances the organization from reactive inspection and problem resolution toward prevention, disciplined problem solving, statistical thinking, robust corrective action, and sustained operational excellence.
 
The Director maintains the effectiveness and certification readiness of applicable quality management systems, including AS9100D and ISO 9001 for aviation, space, defense, and commercial operations; ISO 13485 for medical-device operations where applicable; and customer-, product-, and facility-specific requirements for metal rope, wire rope, cable, and assemblies. The role ensures that customer and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements take precedence where they exceed or conflict with general quality-system requirements.
 
Key Responsibilities
 

* Build, lead, develop, and retain a high-performing organization of Quality professionals across CWI, with clear roles, decision rights, measurable objectives, development plans, succession pipelines, and performance expectations.
* Create a results- and data-driven culture of Quality excellence in which teams use objective evidence, trend analysis, statistical methods, and risk-based thinking to identify priorities, prevent defects, and verify sustained improvement.
* Establish and execute the enterprise Quality strategy, organizational design, staffing plan, technical roadmap, and resource priorities in alignment with CWI business and operating objectives.
* Own enterprise governance for quality management systems and maintain certification readiness for applicable aerospace, commercial, medical, metal rope, and assembly facilities, including registrar, customer, regulatory, and internal audits.
* Ensure aerospace quality controls address AS9100D requirements, including operational risk management, configuration management, product safety, counterfeit-parts prevention, special-process control, production process verification, foreign-object damage prevention, traceability, and awareness of ethical behavior.
* Ensure first article inspection and production process verification practices align with AS9102 when contractually applicable, and ensure special processes are qualified, controlled, and approved to customer, regulatory, or other requirements where applicable.
* Ensure medical quality-system controls align with ISO 13485 and applicable regulatory and customer requirements, including risk management, validated processes, traceability, complaint handling, CAPA, change control, and record retention.
* Establish common standards for document and record control, calibration, inspection and test, nonconforming output, CAPA, root-cause analysis, internal auditing, management review, supplier quality, customer complaints, product and process change control, and continuous improvement.
* Establish an enterprise Quality performance-management system with leading and lagging indicators for customer complaints, escapes, first-pass yield, scrap and rework, cost of poor quality, supplier defects, audit findings, process capability, CAPA aging, recurrence, and corrective-action effectiveness.
* Lead monthly operating reviews and formal management reviews that convert Quality data into executive-level insights, identify systemic and emerging risks, assign accountable owners, and track actions through verified closure.
* Develop Quality leaders who can influence Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Commercial teams; make risk-based decisions; escalate product-safety or conformity concerns; and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Serve as the senior Quality escalation point for significant customer complaints, product escapes, product-safety events, audit findings, systemic nonconformances, supplier-quality issues, and certification or regulatory risks.
* Ensure robust containment, root-cause analysis, corrective action, effectiveness verification, and lessons-learned deployment for significant or recurring failures, including consideration of human factors where relevant.
* Provide enterprise oversight for supplier-quality strategy, supplier qualification, risk-based surveillance, source inspection, flow-down of customer and regulatory requirements, and supplier corrective action.
* Partner with the Chief Operating Officer, Plant Managers, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Commercial, and other leaders to integrate Quality into operational performance, new-product introduction, manufacturing transfers, and change management.
* Communicate Quality-system health, certification status, customer performance, material risks, resource needs, and improvement results clearly to executive leadership and the Board or ownership group when requested.
* Perform other related duties consistent with the role, grade, and business needs.

Required Qualifications
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Materials Science, Metallurgy, Quality, Manufacturing, or a closely related technical discipline.
* Twelve or more years of progressive Quality, manufacturing, engineering, or operational leadership experience in regulated or high-reliability manufacturing.
* At least seven years of direct people-leadership experience, including leadership of Quality managers and professionals, performance management, coaching, organizational design, and succession planning.
* At least five years of multi-site or enterprise Quality leadership experience with accountability for common systems, audits, metrics, and cross-site standardization.
* Demonstrated responsibility for an AS9100D-certified quality management system and successful participation as the senior Quality leader in at least one third-party certification or recertification cycle.
* Demonstrated experience with internal and external audit programs, management review, CAPA, root-cause analysis, configuration and change control, supplier quality, product safety, traceability, nonconformance control, and customer complaint resolution.
* Demonstrated use of Quality data and statistical methods to improve performance, including examples of measurable reduction in defects, escapes, cost of poor quality, or recurring corrective actions.
* Ability to travel approximately 25% to 40% to CWI facilities, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations, with additional travel during significant launches, audits, or quality events.
* Ability to communicate technical and business risk, priorities, decisions, and performance clearly to plant, functional, customer, registrar, and executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications
 

* Experience in specialty metals, wire, cable, wire rope, aircraft cable, mechanical cable, swaging, metal assemblies, or other highly engineered metal products.
* Experience leading Quality in aerospace and defense manufacturing, including customer flow-downs, AS9102 first article inspection, source inspection, special processes, counterfeit-parts controls, configuration management, product safety, and foreign-object damage prevention.
* Experience with ISO 13485-certified medical-device manufacturing and risk-management practices aligned with ISO 14971 where applicable.
* Experience with Nadcap-accredited special processes, Defense Contract Management Agency oversight, Federal Aviation Administration-regulated products, or major aerospace prime and Tier 1 customer requirements, as applicable to CWI’s business.
* Advanced degree in Engineering, Operations, Quality, or Business Administration.
* Experience using an electronic QMS, ERP, business-intelligence, and statistical software to manage Quality performance and traceability.

Preferred Certifications
 

* ASQ Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE) or equivalent senior Quality leadership credential.
* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), ASQ Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or AS9100 Lead Auditor certification.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.
* Certified Manufacturing Engineer, Professional Engineer, Project Management Professional, or comparable technical credential as relevant.

Key Leadership Competencies
 

* Enterprise Quality leadership and culture building
* Leadership, development, and retention of Quality professionals
* Results orientation and measurable accountability
* Data-driven decision making and statistical thinking
* AS9100D, ISO 9001, and regulated quality-system leadership
* Product safety, compliance, and risk-based judgment
* CAPA, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action effectiveness
* Customer quality and executive escalation
* Cross-functional influence and change leadership
* Continuous improvement and operational excellence
* Executive communication and management review
* Multi-site governance and standardization

Leadership Standard
 
Success in this position is measured not simply by maintaining certifications or passing audits, but by the Director’s ability to build capable Quality leaders and teams, establish measurable accountability, improve the effectiveness of CWI’s quality systems, reduce recurring failures and customer escapes, strengthen process capability, protect product safety and conformity, and demonstrate sustained improvement through objective performance data.
 
Physical and Work Environment Requirements
 
The role operates in office and active manufacturing environments and requires regular interaction with plant operations. It may require walking or standing on production floors, observing machinery and manufacturing activities, using a computer and quality information systems, and communicating in areas where hearing protection or other personal protective equipment is required. Travel among company locations, customer sites, supplier sites, and audit locations is expected. Reasonable accommodations will be considered in accordance with applicable law. This description identifies the essential functions of the position but is not intended to list every physical activity or working condition.
 
Base Salary Range

new_roles.title: Sr. Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
The Senior Director of Quality is responsible for leading quality, regulatory compliance, and functions at an assigned facility while providing strategic leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments across multiple FCAH locations and operating companies. This role ensures compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, customer, and industry requirements while driving consistency in quality standards, processes, audit readiness, corrective actions, and continuous improvement throughout the organization.

The Senior Director serves as a hands-on quality leader at their assigned location while partnering with site leadership and other Quality leaders to strengthen quality systems, address regulatory and operational risks, develop quality teams, and promote a culture of accountability, safety, and excellence across the organization.

**Essential Job Functions:**

**Site Quality Leadership**

* Lead and manage the Quality department at the assigned facility, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
* Partner with site leadership, Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other departments to integrate quality into daily operations and decision-making.
* Oversee site quality personnel, including staffing, performance management, training, development, and accountability.
* Ensure the facility maintains required certifications, approvals, manuals, procedures, and quality systems.
* Monitor site quality performance, identify areas of risk, and develop action plans to address deficiencies and improve operational performance.

**Multi-Site Quality Leadership & Support**

* Provide leadership, guidance, and support to Quality departments and leaders across other First Class Air operating companies and locations.
* Partner with site Quality leaders to identify challenges, strengthen quality processes, and improve regulatory compliance and operational effectiveness.
* Promote consistency in quality standards, processes, procedures, and best practices across locations where appropriate.
* Assist other locations with quality initiatives, regulatory concerns, audit preparation, corrective actions, customer issues, and process improvement efforts.
* Conduct site visits to evaluate quality systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and provide support to local Quality teams.
* Share lessons learned, recurring quality issues, and best practices across locations to prevent repeat findings and improve overall organizational performance.
* Help develop and implement company-wide quality initiatives while allowing for site-specific requirements, certifications, and regulatory differences.
* Escalate significant regulatory, operational, customer, or quality risks to executive leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Oversight**

* Ensure compliance with applicable FAA, EASA, UK CAA, , customer, and other regulatory requirements, as applicable to company operations.
* Maintain strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, including Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Serve as a point of contact for regulatory authorities, customer representatives, and external auditors, as appropriate.
* Monitor regulatory changes and ensure applicable requirements are communicated and implemented across affected locations.
* Ensure maintenance, repair, overhaul, inspection, manufacturing, and other applicable activities are performed in accordance with approved technical data, regulatory requirements, and established procedures.
* Maintain organizational readiness for regulatory, customer, and third-party audits.

**Quality Management Systems**

* Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Quality Management Systems (QMS) at the assigned location and across other locations as needed.
* Establish and promote consistent quality standards, policies, procedures, and best practices across the organization.
* Oversee the development, revision, and implementation of quality manuals, procedures, inspection programs, and supporting documentation.
* Ensure appropriate document control, records management, inspection processes, calibration programs, personnel qualifications, training, and other critical quality system controls are maintained.
* Partner with site and enterprise leadership to improve quality processes, reduce risk, and enhance operational performance.

**Audits, Corrective Actions & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead and oversee internal, external, regulatory, customer, and third-party audits at the assigned facility.
* Support and provide guidance to other locations in preparation for and execution of audits.
* Develop and support risk-based audit schedules and audit strategies.
* Ensure audit findings and quality issues are appropriately investigated, contained, corrected, and documented.
* Oversee corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes and ensure root cause analysis is appropriately performed.
* Verify corrective actions are effective and prevent recurring issues.
* Identify recurring findings, systemic quality issues, and trends across locations and implement improvements where appropriate.

**Airworthiness & Technical Quality**

* Provide oversight of airworthiness and return-to-service processes across applicable repair station operations.
* Ensure appropriate controls are maintained for FAA Form 8130-3, EASA Form 1, inspection, certification, and related airworthiness documentation, as applicable.
* Ensure receiving, in-process, and final inspections are performed in accordance with applicable procedures and requirements.
* Oversee the management and control of capability lists, personnel authorizations, technician and inspector qualifications, stamps, and related records.
* Ensure calibration programs and control of tools, equipment, and test instruments meet applicable requirements.
* Assist other locations with technical quality concerns, inspection processes, airworthiness issues, and regulatory interpretations as needed.

**Customer & Supplier Quality**

* Provide leadership and support in resolving significant customer quality concerns, escalations, and recurring issues.
* Partner with Sales, Operations, Maintenance, and other departments to ensure customer quality expectations are understood and met.
* Monitor supplier-related quality trends and recurring issues.
* Support supplier corrective actions, quality investigations, and improvement initiatives as needed.
* Serve as a quality escalation resource for customer and supplier issues across locations.

**Quality Performance, Reporting & Risk Management**

* Establish and monitor quality performance metrics, KPIs, trends, and reporting processes for the assigned facility.
* Support the development and implementation of company-wide quality dashboards and performance metrics.
* Evaluate quality data to identify trends, recurring issues, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Communicate significant quality concerns, regulatory risks, audit findings, and improvement initiatives to site leadership and executive leadership.
* Partner with leadership to prioritize quality initiatives and allocate resources appropriately.
* Provide visibility into quality performance across locations and recommend actions to improve overall company performance.

**Requirements:**

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive experience in aviation, aerospace, MRO, manufacturing, or another highly regulated environment.
* Minimum of 7 years of progressive leadership experience in Quality, Regulatory Compliance,, Inspection, or related functions preferred.
* Significant experience leading Quality functions within aviation maintenance, repair, overhaul, manufacturing, or FAA-certified repair station environments.
* Experience supporting multiple departments, facilities, locations, or business units.
* Experience working directly with FAA, EASA, UK CAA, customer representatives, or other regulatory authorities preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading regulatory, customer, internal, and external audits.
* Experience developing, implementing, and maintaining Quality Management Systems.
* Strong working knowledge of FAA regulations, particularly Part 145, Part 43, and Part 21, as applicable.
* Knowledge of EASA, UK CAA,, and other applicable regulatory requirements preferred.
* Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), corrective and preventive action (CAPA), root cause analysis, risk management, audit processes, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to interpret technical data, regulatory requirements, manuals, procedures, engineering documentation, and quality standards.
* This role will require 20%-30% travel to other facilities
