new_roles.description:
**Location** Gaithersburg, Maryland, United States **Job ID** R-264366 **Date posted** 19/11/2026

 

**WHY JOIN US?**

At AstraZeneca, we are dedicated to being a Great Place to Work, where you are empowered to push the boundaries of science and unleash your entrepreneurial spirit. With an ambitious goal of delivering 20 new medicines by 2030, there is no better place to make a difference in medicine, for patients, and in society.

Join us on this exciting journey to pioneer the future of healthcare. Our inclusive culture champions diversity and collaboration, and we are always committed to lifelong learning, growth, and development. As part of our team, you'll contribute to groundbreaking advancements that will shape a healthier future for people everywhere. Be a catalyst for change at AstraZeneca, where your work will have a real impact on improving people's lives.

Recognizing the importance of individualized flexibility, our ways of working allow employees to balance personal and work commitments while ensuring we continue to create a strong culture of collaboration and teamwork by **engaging face-to-face in our offices 3 days a week**. Our head office is purposely designed with collaboration in mind, providing space where teams can come together to strategize, brainstorm and connect on key projects.**This is a hybrid role located in Gaithersburg, Maryland. Candidates must reside within commuting distance of Gaithersburg or be willing to relocate for this opportunity.****About the Role**

The Director, Quality Systems is a senior leader within Development Quality Biologics (DQB), accountable for strategy, governance, performance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) supporting Biologics Development.

The role provides leadership and oversight for critical Quality Systems processes, including Deviation and CAPA Management, Change Control, Quality Risk Management, Inspection Management, Documentation Management, Quality Management Review, and GxP Training and Learning. The Director also leads Business Process Management (BPM) within DQB, ensuring business and quality processes are effectively owned, defined, governed, measured, and continuously improved.

The Director leads a team of up to 12 employees and partners broadly across DQB, Biopharmaceutical Development (BPD), Development Quality, Global Quality, and other functions to deliver a compliant, efficient, risk-based, and future-ready QMS.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Lead the DQB Quality Management System, providing strategy, governance, and oversight to ensure Quality Systems are compliant, effective, risk-based, phase-appropriate, and fit for purpose.

* Provide leadership for core Quality Systems processes, including deviations and CAPAs, change control, quality risk management, inspection management and readiness, documentation management, Quality Management Review, GxP training, and associated metrics and trending. Champion excellence in fundamental Quality processes like root cause analysis and effective CAPA development, risk mitigation, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement.

* Lead Business Process Management within DQB, establishing clear process ownership, governance, performance measures, and improvement mechanisms. Drive simplification, standardization, and elimination of non-value-added activities while maintaining appropriate compliance and control.

* Drive QMS performance and continuous improvement through meaningful metrics, trending, management review, risk identification, and data-driven insights. Translate QMS performance into clear priorities and actions for DQB and BPD leadership.

* Ensure sustainable inspection readiness, including effective preparation, execution, response, and follow-up for regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring learnings are incorporated into Quality System improvements.

* Lead and develop a team of up to 12 employees, building capability in Quality Systems, process ownership, risk-based decision-making, data and digital fluency, continuous improvement, and critical thinking.

**Shaping the QMS of the Future**

The Director will play a key role in evolving the DQB QMS to support the future needs of the Biologics’ development portfolio and AZ's 2030 Vision. The role will champion a phase-appropriate, risk-based and digitally enabled QMS that is fit for purpose, reduces unnecessary complexity, enables innovation, and maintains strong regulatory compliance and patient-focused quality.

The Director role will lead the responsible adoption of AI, advanced analytics, automation, digital workflows, and other emerging technologies to simplify processes, reduce manual work, improve knowledge access, identify quality signals earlier, and strengthen data-driven decision-making. The role will help advance the QMS from primarily retrospective management of quality events toward a more proactive and predictive model, while ensuring appropriate human accountability, transparency, data integrity, traceability, and GxP controls.

**Measures of Success**

**Success in the role will be demonstrated through:**

* A compliant, effective, phase-appropriate, and fit-for-purpose QMS that enables delivery of the AZ portfolio.

* Strong QMS health, including effective management of deviations, CAPAs, changes, risks, training, documentation, and inspection readiness.

* Mature Business Process Management with clear accountability and measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, and simplicity.

* A Quality Management Review with processes and metrics that provide actionable insights, identify emerging risks, and enable timely leadership decisions.

* Increased and appropriately governed use of data, digital solutions, automation, and AI to improve QMS performance and reduce administrative burden.

* A capable, engaged team prepared to lead and support the QMS of the future.

**Essential Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline such as Pharmacy, Biology, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience within Quality in the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry, including significant people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading a sizeable (10+) Quality team/function and delivering measurable improvements.
* Strong knowledge of Quality Management Systems (QMS), including deviations/CAPA, change control, Quality Risk Management, documentation, training, and inspection readiness.
* Strong understanding of GxP requirements, regulatory expectations, and SOP-driven environments, with experience driving compliance and sustainable Quality practices.
* Experience using Quality metrics, trending, risk indicators, and management review to identify priorities and drive continuous improvement.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and significant process or organizational change, including management of resources, stakeholders, vendors, and budgets.
* Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills with the ability to partner across Quality, Development, and senior leadership.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within biologics, Development Quality, or pharmaceutical development.
* Experience managing managers or leading leaders within a Quality organization.
* Experience with Business Process Management, Operational Excellence, Lean, or continuous improvement.
* Experience leading QMS transformation, harmonization, or process simplification.
* Experience with digital Quality systems, automation, advanced analytics, or AI-enabled Quality solutions in a regulated environment.
* Experience with non-GMP biopharmaceutical work and its phase-appropriate requirements for compliance.

**SO, WHAT’S NEXT?**

To be considered for this exciting opportunity, please complete the full application on our website at your earliest convenience – it is the only way that our Recruiter and Hiring Manager can know that you feel well qualified for this opportunity. If you know someone who would be a great fit, please share this posting with them.

**Are you interested in working at AZ, apply today!**

AstraZeneca is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion and providing a workplace that is free from discrimination. AstraZeneca is committed to accommodating persons with disabilities. Such accommodation is available on request in respect of all aspects of the recruitment, assessment and selection process and may be requested by emailing AZCHumanResources@astrazeneca.com.

Benefits offered included a qualified retirement program [401(k) plan]; paid vacation and holidays; paid leaves; and, health benefits including medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision coverage in accordance with the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.*

*Additional details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer of employment. If hired, employee will be in an “at-will position” and the Company reserves the right to modify base pay (as well as any other discretionary payment or compensation program) at any time, including for reasons related to individual performance, Company or individual department/team performance, and market factors.*

new_roles.title: Director of Quality
new_roles.description:
**About Us:**

BW Design Group is a fully integrated architecture, engineering, construction, system integration, and consulting firm committed to helping our clients realize their most critical goals from Strategy to Commercialization. As the only firm born from a manufacturing technology company to become an independent and fully integrated firm, we combine deep domain expertise in the manufacturing environment with an approach that is built to serve the dynamic needs of our clients. Rooted in our distinct culture of Truly Human Leadership, we cultivate the leaders who will define tomorrow and partner with our clients in the food & beverage, life sciences, industrial, and advanced technology industries to build the future of manufacturing and technology. 
 
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world. 
 

**Job Description:**

**Who You’ll Work With**

At BW Design Group, you'll collaborate with experienced leaders, technical specialists, and subject matter experts to solve complex challenges for some of the world's leading companies. You'll join a growing team of more than 2000 professionals across nearly 50 U.S. offices where you'll be empowered to make an impact, develop your expertise, and grow your career.

As Director, Quality for our Boston office, you will join our Regulatory Compliance Practice, leading the local quality team while serving as a trusted quality subject matter expert, industry thought leader, and client lead for life science clients across New England.

**What You’ll Do**

This role balances hands-on, billable project/service delivery with growing our Boston team, client relationships, and reputation in the industry.

* Lead a team of quality professionals and interface with clients
* Train, mentor, and recruit talent, championing the career growth of early-career professionals through Individual Development Plans and on-the-job coaching.
* Serve as the firm’s local quality SME across QMS maturity, supplier quality, CAPA and deviations, audit and inspection readiness, remediation, and product development, and advise clients on evolving regulatory guidance.
* Lead delivery of multiple concurrent projects, owning scope, budget, schedule, quality, risk, and client satisfaction.
* Drive thought leadership through publications, white papers, and industry conference presentations, and contribute to firmwide quality standards and best practices.
* Maintain a personal billable utilization target of approximately 60–70% while managing team staffing and utilization to meet billable hours goals.
Develop scopes, estimates, and proposals, and expand engagements with new and existing clients through your industry network. 

**What You’ll Bring**

* A minimum of fifteen years of increasing responsibility in quality services and project management for life sciences, biotech, medical device, or other FDA regulated projects.
* A minimum of five years of people leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing quality professionals.
* Proven success in a consulting or professional services environment, including meeting billable utilization goals and leading client relationships
* Experience leading quality teams across capital project handover, QMS establishment, quality audits, root cause and deviation resolution, and remediation planning.
* Working knowledge of quality regulations for medical device, pharmaceuticals, biologics, C&GT, and aseptic/sterile manufacturing (21 CFR Parts 11, 210/211, and 820; ISO 13485; EU GMP), along with cGMP, good documentation practices, and risk management tools (ICH Q9, FMEA, PFMEA/DFMEA).
* Recognized industry expertise and thought leadership through publications, presentations, or professional associations such as ISPE, PDA, or ASQ; a Boston/New England life science network is preferred.
* Strong communication and technical writing skills, with experience developing proposals and estimates is preferred.
* A willingness to travel regionally to client sites throughout the Boston/New England area, as well as for company sponsored meetings, training, and industry events.
A Bachelor of Science in engineering or a related technical degree; an advanced degree or ASQ certification is preferred. 

 

Our culture and commitment to our people is what sets us apart. We foster an environment of mutual respect, integrity, and unconditional interest in the individual and collective success of our professionals. Our model and entrepreneurial mindset offer a rewarding, challenging, and highly flexible path.

 

As Director of Quality, you will build a meaningful and fulfilling career with the support of professional development resources and mentorships including our First Year Experience program, Individual Development Plans, and Career Path resources and tools. You will be surrounded by exceptional talent who will support your development as both a world-class professional and a highly effective leader.

 

*At Barry-Wehmiller we recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying. We know that our differences often can bring about innovation, excellence and meaningful work—therefore, people from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply to our positions. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodations during the interview process.*

Barry-Wehmiller is an equal opportunity employer. M/F/D/V This organization uses E-Verify. 
 
Applicants may be subject to pre-employment screening which may include drug screening, reference checks, employment verifications, background screening and/or skills assessments. 
 

**Company:**

Design Group

new_roles.title: Director Quality
new_roles.description:
### **Activités**

**SUMMARY:**

Reporting to the President, C.E.O., Directs and coordinates activities of personnel at all Hutchinson Sealing Systems facilities engaged in Quality Management System to prevent or eliminate defects in new or existing products or process by performing the following duties personally or through subordinates. This position is designated as a sensitive function for quality, engineering, manufacturing, supplier, audit, compliance, and operational information, including quality performance data, customer requirements, product and process development information, audit findings, corrective actions, supplier performance records, and proprietary company information. The incumbent is responsible for protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets in accordance with company policies and customer requirements.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Analyzes, evaluates, and presents information concerning factors such as quality performance, production capabilities, manufacturing problems, customer quality trends, and quality planning of new products for consideration by other members of the management team.
* Presents and evaluates alternative methods and procedures to establish standardized quality systems based on best practices.
* Participates with other top management personnel in formulating and establishing company policies, operating procedures, and goals.
* Participates in review of product development activities and APQP milestones.
* Conducts Quality System Management review meetings with top management to assess performance and compliance to customer quality requirements.
* Reviews technical problems and procedures of departments and recommends solutions to problems or changes in procedures.
* Confers with engineers and managers about quality assurance of new products and process to improve manufacturing capability.
* Reviews technical publications, articles, and abstracts to stay abreast of technical and quality system developments in industry.
* Travel required on a frequent basis to suppliers and customer facilities as well as other Hutchinson facilities.
* Provides internal quality system audit of Hutchinson Sealing Systems locations.

**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or four to ten years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Qualifications may be waived by management. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:**

None.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

Manages subordinates in department. Is responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of this unit. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complains and resolving problems.

**TEAM SKILLS:**

Hutchinson is built around teamwork. This position requires the use of good team skills such as cooperation, information sharing, task sharing, timely completion of assignments, good listening and communication skills and overall respect for other team members.

**LANGUAGE SKILLS:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to respond to common inquiries or complaints from customers, regulatory agencies, or members of the business community. Ability to write speeches and articles for publication that conform to prescribed style and format. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups and/or boards of directors.

**MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:**

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference, and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations.

**COMPUTER SKILLS:**

Ability to use word processing, spreadsheet applications. Must be familiar with internet research, Microsoft Office software, and the use of e-mail.

**REASONING ABILITY:**

Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT:**

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly exposed to moving mechanical parts. The employee is occasionally exposed to fumes or airborne particles; toxic or caustic chemicals. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close, vision, distance vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus.

**HEALTH AND SAFETY:**

Must actively support our Health Safety and Environmental policy, immediately report all Safety hazards and correct them when able to safely do so, participate in all required Safety Training, meetings, inspects, and use all required PPE.

Vous évoluez au sein d’une compagnie multi-énergies internationale où chaque talent compte. Vous contribuez à des projets ambitieux et apportez des solutions concrètes aux défis énergétiques.

Tout au long de votre carrière, vous bénéficiez de missions variées et de formations sur mesure. Vous développez pleinement votre potentiel dans un environnement qui encourage l’innovation et l’excellence. Intégrez des équipes engagées et solidaires, où la réussite se construit ensemble.

new_roles.title: Vice President of Manufacturing
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**

VP of Manufacturing | Race City Steel

**Location** 
Iron Station, NC

**Reports to** 
VP of Operations and President

About the Role

Race City Steel is hiring a VP of Manufacturing to lead our Iron Station fabrication operation. You’ll manage the fabrication sales and shop floor teams, working directly with the Shop Foreman to improve productivity, quality, and on-time delivery.

Our fabrication shop provides value-added services to Race City Steel’s metal service center locations. The shop handles everything from quick-turn, just-in-time cutting and forming to large, multi-step fabrication orders. You’ll build the processes and capacity to handle both while keeping delivery commitments clear and achievable.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and develop the fabrication sales and shop floor teams. Set clear expectations for communication, quality, productivity, and follow-through.
* Partner with the Shop Foreman on daily priorities, labor assignments, production scheduling, and bottlenecks. Adjust the schedule as rush orders and customer needs change.
* Coordinate with fabrication sales and branch sales teams to review job requirements, confirm capacity and lead times, and communicate changes before they affect customer commitments.
* Serve as the point of accountability for all machine maintenance, troubleshooting, calibration, and performance. Coordinate preventive maintenance, repairs, and outside service for flat lasers, tube lasers, press brakes, welding equipment, and other fabrication machinery.
* Create and improve processes from quote and order handoff through material staging, production, inspection, and shipping.
* Improve warehouse organization, material flow, and job staging so operators have the material, tooling, and information they need when a job is ready to run.
* Establish consistent quality standards and inspection practices. Address recurring defects and rework with the sales and production teams.
* Track on-time delivery, machine uptime, labor productivity, and rework. Use those measures to identify bottlenecks and follow through on improvements.
* Maintain safe work practices and consistent operating standards across the facility.

Qualifications

* Leadership experience in metal fabrication, manufacturing, or a related industrial operation.
* Working knowledge of laser cutting, tube laser cutting, press brake forming, welding, and related fabrication processes.
* Experience leading shop floor teams and coordinating with sales on job requirements, capacity, and customer delivery dates.
* Experience overseeing equipment maintenance and troubleshooting, including working with technicians and outside service providers.
* Ability to read fabrication drawings, understand job requirements, and build practical processes for a shop with changing priorities.
* Strong communication and organizational skills, with the ability to make decisions and follow through from the sales office to the shop floor.

Pay: $85,800.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: VP Operations
new_roles.description:
Daubert Chemical Company is seeking a Vice President of Operations at our specialty chemical plant near Midway airport. The VP leads the functional areas of chemical production, customer service, supply chain, engineering, maintenance and reliability, and EHS. The VP of Operations is a member of the executive team reporting to the CEO, and is accountable for achieving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective operations while consistently meeting product quality standards, customer commitments, and regulatory requirements. This leader will establish clear performance and behavioral expectations, execute with the appropriate sense of urgency, develop organizational capabilities, and drive accountability across all operational functions. 
The successful candidate will balance day-to-day operational execution with long-term strategic planning, continuous improvement and corrective action programs, ensuring that plant equipment, processes, systems, and people are positioned to support business growth and operational excellence. 
This position requires a hands-on, visible leader who demonstrates sound judgment, urgency, follow-up, disciplined problem-solving, and a commitment to improvement and resolution of issues via a methodical corrective action program. The VP of Operations must effectively lead through others, collaborate across departments, and develop sustainable solutions that improve safety, productivity, reliability, product quality, waste reduction, and regulatory compliance. 
 
**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES** include, but not limited to the following.

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of functional managers and operational leaders, establishing clear responsibilities, performance standards, and accountability. Build leadership capability at all levels through coaching, performance feedback, succession planning, and professional development.
* Evaluate organizational structure, staffing levels, technical competencies, and resource requirements to ensure effective operational support.
* Lead operational decision-making with a strong sense of urgency, appropriate prioritization, and consideration of safety, quality, cost, and customer impact.
* Develop and manage departmental operating budgets, control expenditures, evaluate variances, and identify opportunities to improve financial performance.
* Collaborate with Sales, R&D, IT, Procurement, Quality, Finance, and other functions to align operational capabilities with business requirements.
* Provide leadership to production management to optimize plant capacity, equipment utilization, labor resources, product mix, and material availability.
* Develop and ensure execution of a long-range capital investment plan; provide strategic leadership and oversight of plant engineering, equipment performance, reliability initiatives, and capital improvement projects that align with business priorities and integrate safety and environmental considerations.
* Direct the team in the development and effectiveness of preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.
* Provide executive oversight of EHS programs and ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, EPA, state, local, and other regulatory requirements.
* Support effective safety inspections, regulatory audits, incident investigations, corrective actions, and ongoing risk-reduction initiatives.
* Champion the use of structured problem-solving, root cause analysis, 5S, and other appropriate improvement methodologies.
* Foster a culture of respect, teamwork, ownership, continuous learning, and personal accountability.
* Demonstrate and reinforce the company's Core Values: **Reliable, Improving, Fair, and Caring.**

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES**

Directly manages functional leaders. Performs managerial responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws, such as recruitment, selection, training, goals, performance expectations and accountability, compensation management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical discipline required; Chemical Engineering strongly preferred. MBA preferred.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressive manufacturing and operations leadership experience, including at least five years leading managers and multiple operational functions.
* Significant leadership experience in specialty chemical manufacturing, batch processing, or a comparable process manufacturing environment strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated responsibility for managing and improving cost optimization with a multi-million-dollar operational budget in manufacturing operations, engineering, maintenance, equipment reliability, capital projects, and resource allocation.
* Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment with strong safety, environmental, and process compliance requirements.
* Proven experience developing and executing operational improvement initiatives with measurable business results.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and managing competing operational priorities in a manufacturing plant.
* Support change management and transactional integrity within the new ERP, Microsoft Dynamics - D365.
* Expertise in methodologies like Lean or Six Sigma to streamline plant throughput and reduce waste.
* Exhibits solid judgement along with decision making skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills as well as interpersonal, analytical and presentation skills.
* Must read, speak and write English fluently.
* Strong attention to detail with solid organizational and planning skills.
* High degree of professional integrity, ethics and confidentiality.
* Ability to learn company ERP. Requires advances proficiency with MS Office suite i.e. Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, etc.

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**

* Base salary range $209,000-235,000, plus management incentive bonus plan
* BCBS of Illinois Medical & Dental. Vision Service Plan.
* 401(k) Savings Plan + generous company match
* Paid time off with 11 annual Holidays
* Disability, Family, & Military Leave
* Life Insurance, Identity Protection, and more!

Relocation assistance is not available. Must be authorized to work in the U.S.

Daubert Chemical Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Disability/Veteran.

new_roles.title: Plant Manager
new_roles.description:
Description:

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Plant Manager to oversee the daily operations of our manufacturing facility. The ideal candidate will be a strategic leader with a strong background in production management, quality control, and team leadership. This is an excellent opportunity to contribute to a dynamic organization committed to excellence and continuous improvement.

*Benefits effective day one, paid vacation, free on-site health clinic, on-site fitness center, and 401(k) with matching.*

**Mayfran International** is located in Mayfield, Ohio

**Who We Are at Mayfran International**

Mayfran International is the world’s leading provider of material handling, coolant filtration, chip processing and recycling systems, with a focus on engineering and innovation. The Mayfran name has been synonymous with quality throughout our history. Our products are designed for the most challenging applications in aerospace, automotive, energy, medical, heavy equipment and other specialized industries. Our recycling solutions include equipment for metal scrap management, aluminum scrap separation, chip handling and more. We are also well known for our lifetime commitment to service and genuine aftermarket parts replacement guarantee. Customers know that working with Mayfran is about more than a product, it’s a relationship and an investment. As a part of the Tsubaki Group—a global leader in motion control products for over 100 years—we’re committed to advancing the art of moving. Mayfran is committed to staying one step ahead, helping you succeed in ever-changing industries and an evolving marketplace.

**Culture**

Employees at Mayfran are part of a team and work in a positive environment that is geared toward helping everyone succeed. We value each team member for the skills they provide, their hard work and dedication. We treat every team member with warmth and respect and embrace their differences, cultures, customs and beliefs.

**Sustainability**

Mayfran strives to achieve sustainable growth by committing to corporate social responsibilities while recognizing its duty to contribute to society with ethical, sustainable business practices. We are tackling a variety of issues to promote sustainability in the short, medium and long terms. We prioritize material issues and set strict sustainability targets at the corporate level to ensure that our commitment to corporate sustainability does not waver.

**Summary:** Directs and coordinates all production operations at the plant to achieve established safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity objectives. Provides visible, hands-on leadership on the plant floor and holds production supervisors accountable for daily execution and continuous improvement.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS INCLUDE THE FOLLOWING. OTHER DUTIES MAY BE ASSIGNED:**

* Plans, coordinates, and controls daily production operations while remaining actively engaged on the plant floor. Ensures production schedules, staffing, capacity, equipment, materials, and priorities are aligned to meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity targets.
* Establishes areas of responsibility for production supervisors and gives general direction to production leadership.
* Maintains discipline, morale, and effective employee relations within production.
* Develops plans for efficient use of materials, machines, and production employees.
* Establishes, reviews, and acts on production performance metrics, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, productivity, labor efficiency, scrap, rework, downtime, and cost. Ensures unfavorable trends have clear owners, corrective actions, and completion dates.
* Sets operating standards and leads a consistent daily management process to review safety, quality, delivery, cost, staffing, and equipment performance. Ensures gaps are escalated, assigned, corrected, and followed through to completion.
* Works with the VP of Operations and the Quality, Safety, Maintenance, and Warehousing functions, as well as Engineering, Sales, Supply Chain, vendors, and customers, to resolve production constraints, quality concerns, material issues, and customer requirements.
* Organizes and directs the production work force to ensure adherence to customer, regulatory, and company requirements.
* Leads the implementation and sustained use of manufacturing processes, equipment, and standards on the plant floor in partnership with Engineering and Quality.
* Leads and implements improvements to manufacturing methods, workflow, equipment, layout, and related systems to improve safety, quality, throughput, reliability, labor efficiency, and cost.
* Recommends the production budget to the VP of Operations and manages production spending within the approved budget.
* Makes effective recommendations for promotions, transfers, and terminations of production employees.

**SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY:** Manages production supervisors who supervise employees in all production departments. Responsible for the overall direction, coordination, and evaluation of these units. Responsibilities include training, planning, assigning, and directing work, appraising performance, addressing complaints and resolving problems.

 
Requirements:

**Competencies:**

* Analytical - Collects and researches data.
* Problem Solving - Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; Gathers and analyzes information skillfully.
* Customer Service - Responds promptly to customer needs; Returns phone-calls and e-mails within 24-hours except for weekends and other time off. Meets commitments.
* Change Management - Develops workable implementation plans; Builds commitment and overcomes resistance; Monitors transition and evaluates results.
* Delegation - Delegates work assignments; Matches the responsibility to the person; Gives authority to work independently; Sets expectations and monitors delegated activities; Provides recognition for results.
* Leadership - Exhibits confidence in self and others; Inspires and motivates others to perform well; effectively influences actions and opinions of others; Accepts feedback from others.
* Managing People - Includes staff in planning, decision-making, facilitating and process improvement; Takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; Makes self available to staff; Provides regular performance feedback; Develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; Solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); Fosters quality focus in others; Improves processes, products and services.; Continually works to improve supervisory skills.
* Business Acumen - Understands business implications of decisions; Displays orientation to profitability; Aligns work with strategic goals.
* Cost Consciousness - Works within approved budget; Develops and implements cost saving measures; Conserves organizational resources.
* Judgment - Displays willingness to make decisions; Exhibits sound and accurate judgment; Supports and explains reasoning for decisions; Includes appropriate people in decision-making process; Makes timely decisions.
* Motivation - Sets and achieves challenging goals; Demonstrates persistence and overcomes obstacles.
* Planning/Organizing - Prioritizes and plans work activities; Uses time efficiently; Plans for additional resources; Sets goals and objectives; Organizes or schedules other people and their tasks.
* Professionalism - Accepts responsibility for own actions; Follows through on commitments. Maintains confidentiality
* Written Communication - Presents data effectively.
* Oral Communication - Listens and gets clarification; Participates in meetings.
* Technical Skills - Assesses own strengths and weaknesses; Pursues training and development opportunities; Strives to continuously build knowledge and skills; Shares expertise with others.
* Initiative - Seeks increased responsibilities.
* Innovation - Meets challenges with resourcefulness.
* Adaptability - Manages competing demands.
* Teamwork - Balances team and individual responsibilities; Exhibits objectivity and openness to others' views; Gives and welcomes feedback; Contributes to building a positive team spirit; Puts success of team above own interests; Able to build morale and group commitments to goals and objectives; Supports everyone's efforts to succeed.
* Organizational Support - Follows policies and procedures; Completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; Supports organization's goals and values.
* Quality - Demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness; Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; Applies feedback to improve performance; Monitors own work to ensure quality.
* Diversity - Promotes a harassment-free environment.
* Safety and Security - Observes safety and security procedures.

**QUALIFICATIONS:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

**Education and/or Experience:** Master's degree (M.A.) or equivalent; or 10 to 15 years of progressively responsible manufacturing operations experience and/or training; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Experience leading plant-floor production through supervisors and delivering measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost is required.

**Computer Skills**: MS Office, Epicor Kinetic. Epicor experience is required, with the ability to operate independently through the entire workflow, from order entry, planning, and scheduling through production, inventory, and shipping.

**Travel**: As needed.

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** While performing the essentials duties of this job, the employee is frequently required to sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

*The specific statements shown in each section of this description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria necessary to successfully perform the job. new_roles.title: Director of Offsite Production - Fabrication
new_roles.description:
**At ACI we build our company and our culture not by counting people, but by making our people count!**

Atlantic Constructors is seeking dynamic, motivated, career minded individuals to join our expanding team! Atlantic Constructors has been recognized as an industry leader in the Mid-Atlantic Region for over 50 years.

**Benefits:**

* ***$0.00 COST FOR MEDICAL, DENTAL, SHORT TERM DISABILITYLIFE INSURANCE (EMPLOYEE ONLY) COVERAGE!***
* Dental Insurance Plan
* Vision Insurance Plan
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Health Savings Plan with Generous Company Matching
* Wellness Programs

Atlantic Constructors offers competitive benefits, for more information check out our comprehensive list on our website. ACIBuilds.com

**Role Overview:**
==================

The Director of Offsite Production is responsible for the leadership, performance, and continued growth of offsite production across company facilities. The role oversees carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication and non-volumetric prefabrication and manufacturing, including pipe racks, equipment skids, supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies. The Director establishes the operating systems, production standards, capacity, and cross-functional coordination required to deliver safe, compliant, high-quality work on schedule.

This leader is accountable for implementing improvements that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability. The Director will implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, eliminate waste and production constraints, reduce rework, and create repeatable processes that support scalable offsite manufacturing. The position works closely with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, and field operations to align production with project and business objectives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Offsite Production Leadership**
---------------------------------

* Provide enterprise leadership for pipe fabrication, prefabrication, and manufacturing operations across company facilities and approved external production partners.
* Translate backlog, project schedules, and sales forecasts into capacity plans, staffing requirements, production priorities, and facility needs.
* Establish a consistent operating cadence for production planning, readiness reviews, constraint management, performance reporting, and executive escalation.
* Develop scalable operating standards that support growth while maintaining safety, quality, cost control, and predictable delivery performance.
* Coordinate work across facilities to balance demand, available labor, equipment, and production capability.

**Pipe Fabrication Operations**
-------------------------------

* Direct carbon and stainless steel pipe fabrication operations, including material receiving, cutting, beveling, fit-up, welding, inspection, testing, coating coordination, staging, and shipment.
* Ensure spool sequencing, production release, shop loading, and work packaging align with approved drawings, project priorities, and field installation requirements.
* Maintain compliance with applicable codes, specifications, welding procedures, ASME and AWS requirements, customer quality plans, and company standards.
* Improve material traceability, weld documentation, inspection records, testing status, and turnover packages for fabricated systems.

**Prefabrication and Manufacturing Operations**
-----------------------------------------------

* Lead production of non-volumetric prefabricated assemblies, including pipe racks, equipment skids, structural supports, frames, and multi-trade assemblies.
* Develop repeatable production cells, workstations, tooling, fixtures, travelers, and assembly sequences that improve flow and reduce variation.
* Ensure manufacturing plans account for structural, mechanical, electrical, controls, insulation, coatings, testing, preservation, packaging, and logistics requirements, as applicable.
* Support the transition of first-of-a-kind work into stable, repeatable production through lessons learned, standardized design, and controlled process updates.

**Production Planning and Readiness**
-------------------------------------

* Establish production-readiness criteria to confirm approved drawings, bills of material, work instructions, quality requirements, tooling, materials, and labor are available before work is released.
* Partner with Engineering and VDC to improve constructability, spool and assembly breakdown, drawing release sequencing, and design for manufacturing and assembly.
* Coordinate with Procurement and material-control teams to maintain visibility to shortages, supplier commitments, receiving status, kitting, and point-of-use material availability.
* Identify production constraints early, assign recovery actions, and communicate schedule or capacity risks to Project Management and executive leadership.
* Maintain production schedules that clearly identify priorities, dependencies, resource loading, planned output, and required shipment dates.

**Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement**
-------------------------------------------------

* Lead continuous-improvement initiatives that increase production capacity, labor productivity, throughput, and schedule reliability across all offsite operations.
* Implement and sustain Lean manufacturing methodologies, including 5S, standard work, value-stream mapping, visual management, cellular production, daily tiered accountability, Kaizen events, mistake-proofing, and continuous-flow principles.
* Evaluate workflows, facility layouts, material movement, staffing, tooling, and equipment utilization to identify and eliminate bottlenecks, waste, waiting, excess handling, rework, and other non-value-added activity.
* Use time studies, cycle-time analysis, workload balancing, root-cause analysis, and structured problem-solving to improve production performance and reduce manufacturing lead time.
* Develop and maintain standard work instructions and repeatable manufacturing processes that improve safety, quality, training effectiveness, and output predictability.
* Lead initiatives to reduce setup and changeover time, control work in process, improve material flow, and increase productive labor utilization.
* Maintain an improvement pipeline with defined owners, target benefits, implementation dates, and verified results; ensure completed improvements are standardized and sustained.
* Evaluate and implement automation, machinery, software, tooling, and manufacturing technologies that improve safety, quality, efficiency, and capacity.

**Throughput Capacity and Performance Management**
--------------------------------------------------

* Establish production targets and capacity models based on takt time, cycle time, labor availability, equipment constraints, facility limits, and project demand.
* Track and improve key performance indicators such as safety performance, labor hours per spool or assembly, plan attainment, throughput, work in process, first-pass yield, rework, equipment utilization, and on-time completion and shipment.
* Develop visual dashboards and tiered performance reviews that provide timely, accurate information to supervisors, project teams, and executive leadership.
* Analyze performance gaps, determine root causes, implement corrective and preventive actions, and verify that results are sustained.
* Use production data to validate estimating assumptions, workforce plans, capital investments, and future capacity requirements.

**Supplier and External Fabrication Partner Management**
--------------------------------------------------------

* Qualify, onboard, and manage third-party fabrication and manufacturing partners when additional capacity or specialized capability is required.
* Define scopes of work, quality requirements, documentation, inspection points, schedule expectations, material responsibilities, and delivery requirements for outsourced work.
* Monitor supplier performance for safety, quality, responsiveness, cost, schedule adherence, and corrective-action closure.
* Coordinate external production with internal Engineering, Procurement, Quality, Project Management, and logistics teams.

**Estimating and Preconstruction Support**
------------------------------------------

* Support Estimating and Preconstruction with production strategies, labor assumptions, production rates, facility requirements, tooling, equipment, subcontract capacity, and logistics considerations.
* Review proposed scope, drawings, specifications, and schedules to identify production risks, constructability issues, testing requirements, and opportunities for prefabrication or standardization.
* Provide fact-based labor and throughput data to improve estimate accuracy and establish achievable production commitments.
* Participate in make-or-buy decisions and recommend the most effective production approach based on capability, capacity, cost, risk, and schedule.

**Quality Safety and Delivery**
-------------------------------

* Promote a production culture in which safety, quality, and operational discipline are built into the process and are never traded for output.
* Partner with Safety and Quality leaders to establish training, inspections, hold points, audits, nonconformance controls, and corrective-action processes.
* Ensure completed work is inspected, tested, documented, preserved, packaged, and released in accordance with project and company requirements.
* Drive reduction of defects, weld repairs, material damage, punch-list items, field rework, and incomplete turnover documentation.
* Coordinate staging, loading, transportation readiness, and shipment sequencing to support safe handling and efficient field installation.

**Team Leadership and Development**
-----------------------------------

* Build and lead an accountable organization of production managers, superintendents, supervisors, planners, coordinators, and skilled craft professionals.
* Define roles, decision rights, staffing plans, performance expectations, and development paths for the offsite production team.
* Train leaders and production personnel in Lean principles, standard work, problem-solving, root-cause analysis, visual management, and data-driven decision-making.
* Develop succession plans and cross-training programs that increase workforce flexibility and reduce dependency on single points of knowledge.
* Create a culture of ownership, urgency, teamwork, continuous improvement, and respect for people.

**Qualifications and Experience**
=================================

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, construction management, manufacturing, operations, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
* Ten or more years of progressive experience in fabrication, prefabrication, manufacturing, construction operations, or a closely related production environment, including significant leadership responsibility.
* Demonstrated success improving production throughput, labor productivity, quality, schedule performance, and operating discipline.
* Practical experience implementing Lean manufacturing or continuous-improvement systems in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of pipe fabrication, welding, structural fabrication, production planning, material control, quality systems, and shop operations.
* Ability to build capacity plans, interpret production data, identify constraints, and translate performance information into corrective action.
* Experience coordinating with Estimating, Engineering, VDC, Procurement, Project Management, Quality, Safety, suppliers, and field teams.
* Strong leadership, communication, organizational, financial, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple facilities and competing priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* Lean Six Sigma certification or equivalent formal training in Lean manufacturing and continuous improvement.
* Experience with ASME, AWS, weld-quality programs, fabrication codes, and customer-specific quality requirements.
* Experience with production-planning, ERP, manufacturing execution, scheduling, and performance-dashboard systems.
* Working knowledge of fabrication and detailing platforms such as Stratus, Tekla, SpoolFab, or comparable systems.
* Experience establishing or expanding multi-facility prefabrication and manufacturing operations.
* Experience implementing automation, advanced tooling, production-line design, and capital improvement projects

Visit us at www.acibuilds.com for more information!

*Final compensation will be determined based on applicable experience, education, licensure, skills, and other relevant factors*

*Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

A fully executed MSA with the applicable group entity and prior written authorization and acceptance of each candidate submission by an authorized representative are required. Unsolicited submissions do not establish candidate ownership or create any obligation to pay placement fees, even if the candidate is subsequently hired.*

new_roles.title: Senior Director - Customer Experience and Quality
new_roles.description:
Job Overview
 
The Sr. Director, Customer Experience & Quality owns the enterprise-wide direction and execution of Vontier Convenience Retails’ global strategy for customer experience, product quality, and reliability. The role serves as the senior advocate for the customer, this leader establishes global standards, governance, and priorities across global functions. Translating customer feedback, field performance, warranty data, and quality insights into priorities that improve products, services, processes, and support. This leader provides oversight and direction for improving the customer experience and connects Design for Reliability, Supplier Quality Management, Manufacturing Process Control, field quality, and Customer Service & Support into an integrated end-to-end customer experience. Working closely with commercial, product, engineering, procurement, manufacturing, service, and regional leaders, this position drives rapid issue resolution, systemic corrective action, and continuous improvement across the full product life cycle to increase customer satisfaction, loyalty, and business performance.
 
Responsibilities
 

* Own, create, and execute the enterprise-wide global customer experience and quality strategy, setting direction, priorities, and standards, and measurable objectives that advance business objectives, strengthens customer loyalty, and continuously improves customer outcomes.
* Establish and govern a disciplined enterprise voice-of-customer process that integrates customer feedback, complaints, service data, warranty trends, and field performance into product and operational priorities.
* Own and direct the global customer issue management and escalation process, ensuring rapid containment, transparent communication, root-cause resolution, and verification of corrective-action effectiveness.
* Build trusted relationships with strategic customers and customer quality teams; represent the business in quality reviews, escalations, and long-range improvement planning, with accountability for commitments and customer outcomes
* Implement and further develop the Vontier Reliability System to improve product reliability, serviceability, and customer experience across the installed base.
* Develop and lead a multi-year enterprise deployment plan aligned to the customer experience and quality strategy, including performance targets, resources, processes, governance, and organizational capability.
* Collaborate with Product Management, Engineering, Commercial, Service, Procurement, and Manufacturing to embed customer requirements and quality controls from concept through end of life.
* Develop, govern, and continuously improve an integrated enterprise performance system covering customer satisfaction, complaint responsiveness, repeat issues, field reliability, warranty, external PPM, first-pass yield, and cost of poor quality.
* Act as the customer experience and quality advisor to the Vontier Convenience Retail Executive team, using data and customer insights to influence priorities, investment decisions, and accountability.
* Build and lead a high-performing global team and foster a culture of customer focus, collaboration, problem solving, prevention, and continuous improvement.
* Ability to travel up to 30% of working time.

Required Skills / Qualifications / Certifications / Tech Stack
 
Essential
 

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, Operations, or a related discipline.
* 10+ years of experience in quality, engineering, operations, service, or customer facing role within a complex product or manufacturing environment.
* 5+ years of leadership experience with accountability for quality performance, customer outcomes, and cross-functional improvement.
* Demonstrated success leading complex customer escalations, complaint resolution, root-cause analysis, corrective action, and executive-level customer communication.
* In-depth knowledge of quality management systems, product reliability, continuous improvement methods, and standards such as ISO 9001.
* Ability to translate voice-of-customer, field, warranty, and quality data into priorities, measurable action plans, and improved customer outcomes.
* Strong enterprise program change, and organizational leadership skills, with the ability to align global and cross-functional teams around complex business problems, and sustain accountability across functions and regions
* Executive-level communication, influencing, coaching, and relationship-building skills with customers, employees, suppliers, and senior leaders; willingness and ability to travel globally.

Preferable
 

* Advanced technical degree or an MBA is a plus.
* ASQ certification or equivalent (e.g., CMQ/OE, CQE)
* Extensive experience in lean manufacturing; including problem solving and use of kaizen
* Experience working with external partners (suppliers, customers, agencies) to accelerate progress and deliver results.
* Worked directly in or in supporting roles to software development, quality assurance, customer roll-out and software investigation and bug fix resolution.
* Customer facing experience working in roles such as customer service, order management, customer success, application engineering, key account management or sales.

Outcomes and Deliverables
 
Deliverables
 

* Global customer experience and quality strategy with a multi-year deployment plan, clear ownership, resources, governance, capability requirements, and measurable business targets.
* Enterprise voice-of-customer and customer issue management processes, including escalation governance, response standards, root-cause resolution, corrective-action verification, and closed-loop customer communication.
* Integrated customer experience and quality performance system, including dashboards and review routines for customer satisfaction, complaint response, repeat issues, reliability, warranty, external PPM, supplier quality, and cost of poor quality.

Outcomes
 

* A doubling of Net Promoter Scores for “Raving Fans” key customers over a 3 year strategic planning horizon

About Vontier
 
**Vontier (NYSE:** VNT) is a global industrial technology company uniting productivity, automation and multi-energy technologies to meet the needs of a rapidly evolving, more connected mobility ecosystem. Leveraging leading market positions, decades of domain expertise and unparalleled portfolio breadth, Vontier powers the way the world moves – delivering smart, safe and sustainable solutions to our customers and the planet. Vontier has a culture of continuous improvement and innovation worldwide. Additional information about Vontier is available on the Company’s website at www.vontier.com.

new_roles.title: Director, Dental Furniture Operations
new_roles.description:
At A-dec, we do more than create the highest quality products and services for the dental industry; we strive to deliver a superior employment experience for each of our team members. With an environment that encourages and assists each person in developing to their highest potential, a career at A-dec is incredibly rewarding.

**Overview**
------------

The Director, Dental Furniture Operations provides strategic direction and end-to-end operational oversight for A-dec’s dental furniture value stream at the Newberg campus. The role leads manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning for the value stream and is accountable for delivering the dental furniture business plan, including safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity growth. The Director partners with product line leadership and functions across Manufacturing and the enterprise to translate product and demand plans into a scalable, high-mix, engineered-to-order operation, while strengthening woodworking capability and continuous improvement.

**KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES:**

* End-to-end performance of the Dental Furniture value stream: safety, quality, on-time delivery, cost, and inventory against the business plan.
* Dental Furniture purchasing and production and materials planning, including supplier performance, material availability, and inventory levels.
* Capacity, workforce, equipment, and space plans that support Dental Furniture growth and new product introductions.
* Leadership bench strength and succession for all managers and critical roles in assigned areas.

**JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Lead the managers responsible for manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning. Define the area’s operating system, including standards, tiered performance reviews, and escalation paths, and hold managers accountable for meeting customer and company safety, quality, delivery, and cost standards.
* Develop annual business plans and budgets, including key performance indicators; assess current capacity and capability and establish multi-year plans for workforce, equipment, space, and investment to meet forecasted demand and support growth; prepare business cases for capital and expense needs.
* Set direction for Dental Furniture manufacturing engineering, including process technology, automation, and capital project priorities that improve safety, quality, throughput, and cost and strengthen woodworking capability.
* Own purchasing and production and materials planning for the Dental Furniture line, including supplier selection and performance, material availability, and inventory targets; operate within enterprise purchasing policies, partner with Global Sourcing on commodity strategy and shared suppliers, and represent the value stream in the enterprise SIOP process.
* Partner with product line leadership, Product Development, and Marketing to translate product strategy, roadmap, and pricing into executable operational initiatives and support the transition of new products into production.
* Set annual targets for safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and efficiency; own results and lead monthly operating reviews with managers to set priorities and drive systemic corrective action.
* Lead deployment of lean manufacturing and continuous improvement across assigned areas; set and prioritize the improvement portfolio against the business plan and build a culture of creative problem solving, collaboration, learning, and development.
* Ensure operations within assigned areas comply with company safety, regulatory, and quality policies and applicable environmental requirements; partner with Environmental Health and Safety, Quality, and other functions to address risks and sustain compliance.
* Set performance objectives for direct reports, review results, and hold them accountable for achieving annual business objectives; take appropriate corrective action when needed.
* + Own workforce strategy for assigned areas: with managers, assess capabilities, close skill and staffing gaps, and plan labor against forecasted demand. Develop managers and maintain succession plans for critical roles.
 + Partner with People & Culture to lead organizational design, change management, and employee engagement; promote a respectful, inclusive, and people-focused work environment.
 + Partner with the Director, Manufacturing Operations – Machining & Maintenance on machined-component supply, maintenance service levels, and equipment reliability, and with other Manufacturing leaders on shared capabilities and capital priorities that support Dental Furniture operations.
 + Communicate value-stream priorities, performance, risks, and resource needs to executive leadership, peers, and employees.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Demonstrated ability to lead managers across manufacturing, manufacturing engineering, purchasing, and planning.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including high-mix, engineered-to-order production and woodworking or related manufacturing processes.
* Ability to develop and execute business plans, budgets, capacity strategies, and capital priorities aligned with product and business goals.
* Understanding of manufacturing engineering, automation, and capital investment planning.
* Ability to interpret operational and financial data and use performance measures to guide decisions that improve safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and capacity.
* Effective communication, relationship-building, and change leadership skills, including the ability to work across product line leadership, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, and other functions.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and make timely decisions in a changing manufacturing environment.

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, business, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible experience in manufacturing or operations leadership, including at least four years in a senior leadership role.
* Experience leading production planning, materials planning, and purchasing, with accountability for inventory, supplier performance, and SIOP participation.
* Experience leading lean manufacturing and continuous improvement deployment.
* Demonstrated experience leading managers and coordinating multiple functions within a manufacturing value stream.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in business, engineering, operations, or a related field.
* Experience in furniture, woodworking, high-mix, engineered-to-order, or medical device manufacturing.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other continuous improvement certification.

**Physical Requirements:**

Ability to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise maneuver up to 35 pounds with or without assistance on a routine basis. Must have manual hand dexterity to grasp, operate tools and equipment repetitively. Able to walk, stand, sit, bend, reach, and occasionally kneel, climb steps, and twist throughout an entire shift. Some areas may be exposed to chemicals, noise, vibration and /or dust, and require the use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE); such as, but not limited to safety glasses, hearing protection, foot protection, etc.

**Disclaimer**

This job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not to be construed as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job. A-dec reserves the right to assign job duties and days and hours of work based on factors such as workload requirements, staffing levels, and customer demands.

At A-dec, we value our people and show it by prioritizing an inclusive culture, total well-being, and opportunities for learning and career advancement.

**A background check and screen for the illegal use of drugs is required.** 
 
*A-dec is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. In addition, A-dec will not discriminate against applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another. \*VEVRAA Federal Contractor”*

*A-dec is interested in qualified candidates authorized to work in the United States for US-based positions. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*

new_roles.description:
Why Hershey:

At The Hershey Company, our culture is rooted in purpose and inspired by Milton Hershey’s enduring vision that business should create opportunity for others. Through our commitment to corporate philanthropy, we create positive impact by supporting communities, helping children thrive, and operating as a business for good. This includes our deep and long standing partnership with Milton Hershey School, where we invest in education, workforce readiness, and hands on engagement to help students succeed beyond the classroom. Supported by strategic grantmaking, product donations, cross brand collaboration, and strong employee volunteerism, Hershey offers a place to work where making a difference—locally and globally—is part of how we do business every day.

 

Location: This role is based in Hershey, PA with an expectation of 3 days in office per week.

**About the Hershey Company**
-----------------------------

At The Hershey Company, we make more moments of goodness through some of the world's most iconic brands, including Hershey's, Reese's, Kit Kat®, Jolly Rancher, Twizzlers, Dot's Pretzels, Lesser Evil and more. Our team supports a global portfolio of over 90 brands, creating opportunities to shape strategies and drive impact across a breadth of businesses that few companies can offer. While many organizations focus on a handful of brands, Hershey provides exposure to a diverse portfolio of category-leading brands enjoyed by consumers around the world. What truly sets us apart is our legacy. Inspired by Milton Hershey's belief that business should create opportunities for others, we have been making a positive impact for more than a century through our commitment to communities, philanthropy, and our longstanding partnership with Milton Hershey School. When you join Hershey, you become part of a company where purpose, growth, and making a difference are woven into how we do business every day.

**How will you fit in the big picture?**
----------------------------------------

The Director, Hershey Lean System & Manufacturing Transformation serves as the enterprise owner of the Hershey Lean Production System, or HLPS, and leads the continued evolution of Lean manufacturing across Hershey’s global manufacturing network.

 

This leader defines strategy, governance, standards, maturity model, deployment approach and capability requirements for HLPS. The Director partners with plant and functional leaders to eliminate systemic losses, strengthen operator ownership and accelerate manufacturing transformation through digital Lean, connected-worker solutions, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacity optimization.

 

The role ensures a consistent enterprise operating system while enabling each site to deploy HLPS according to its business needs, maturity and performance priorities.

**What will you do?**
---------------------

* **Own HLPS strategy and governance:** Define and maintain the HLPS architecture, principles, pillar standards, maturity model, assessment methodology, deployment roadmap and governance routines. Set the multi-year strategy and annual priorities, benchmark externally and translate proven practices into enterprise standards.
* **Lead network deployment:** Partner with Plant Managers to establish site transformation roadmaps, conduct quarterly progress reviews, address enterprise barriers, require recovery plans for material gaps and accelerate the replication of successful practices.
* **Build Lean leadership capability:** Establish role-based capability expectations, learning pathways, qualifications and coaching models for plants, Operational Excellence, engineering and frontline leaders. Build internal coaches and assessors while strengthening Daily Management, Leader Standard Work, structured problem solving, Autonomous Maintenance and Focused Improvement.
* **Advance manufacturing transformation:** Lead strategy and governance for assigned initiatives in digital Lean, connected worker, labor optimization, automation enablement and capacityoptimization. Establish prioritization, pilot criteria, stage gates, value-realization requirements and scalable deployment standards in partnership with Engineering, Supply Chain Strategy, Digital/IT and Finance.
* **Deliver measurable business value:** Translate operational losses and capability gaps into an enterprise improvement portfolio. Connect HLPS maturity to safety, quality, delivery, cost, reliability, productivity and people outcomes, partnering with Finance to validate benefits.
* **Lead and develop the team:** Guide Lean Program Leads and transformation and technical resources, focusing support on the network’s highest-value opportunities.

**Minimum Education & Requirements**
------------------------------------

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, supply chain, business or related discipline.
* Master’s degree preferred.

 

**Experience:**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in manufacturing, operations, engineering or Operational Excellence, including 5+ years leading leaders, multi-site programs or enterprise-scale manufacturing transformation.
* Demonstrated success designing, deploying or materially advancing Lean, Total Productive Maintenance, or a manufacturing operating system across multiple sites.
* Strong knowledge of Lean management systems, TPM, Daily Management, structured problem solving, loss analysis, asset reliability and capability development.
* Proven ability to influence Plant Managers and senior cross-functional stakeholders without relying on direct authority.
* Strong executive communication, coaching and change-leadership skills.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or equivalent demonstrated experience preferred.
* Experience in automated or capital-intensive manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Previous leadership of a manufacturing site, major production operation or enterprise or multi-site Operational Excellence transformation strongly preferred.
* Consumer packaged goods, food and beverage, or other regulated manufacturing experience preferred.

**Benefits and Perks**
----------------------

At Hershey, we offer competitive pay and a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, financial security, and life outside of work.

* Health & Wellbeing: Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus wellness programs that support your physical and mental health begin on Day 1.
* Financial Security: Competitive pay, annual incentive opportunities, and a 401(k) with company match
* Time Off & Flexibility: Paid time off, company holidays, and flexible ways of working where applicable
* Growth & Development: Career development programs, learning opportunities, and internal mobility

 

*Benefits may vary based on role, location, and eligibility.*

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $166,400 to $208,000 per year. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of job‑related factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skill set, education, and training. In addition to a market-competitive base salary, our Total Rewards package includes performance‑based incentives and a comprehensive, competitive benefits package designed to support overall physical, mental, and financial well‑being (as applicable). Learn more about Hershey’s benefits and all the resources Hershey provides to support our employees’ physical, emotional, and financial well‑being by visiting the Hershey Digital Employee Experience at www.askHRbenefits.hersheys.com

You may also email a request for accommodation to ApplicationHelp@hersheys.com. Please be sure to include “Accommodation Needed” in the subject line.
