new_roles.title: Supply Chain Director of Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
1.0 FTE Full time Day - 08 Hour R2655441 Hybrid 108400006 SC Administration Business & Administration PALO ALTO, 1840 Embarcadero, California

If you're ready to be part of our legacy of hope and innovation, we encourage you to take the first step and explore our current job openings. Your best is waiting to be discovered.

 
Day - 08 Hour (United States of America)

**This is a Stanford Health Care job.** 
 
**A Brief Overview** 
The Director of Supply Chain Operational Excellence is a senior leadership role driving enterprise‑wide efficiency, innovation, and transformation across a Gartner top‑2 ranked healthcare supply chain. With system‑wide influence and a seat at the leadership table, this role partners closely with the Chief Supply Chain Officer and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives to turn strategy into measurable results. The ideal candidate combines healthcare supply chain expertise with strong program management skills and a passion for developing people, leading change, and delivering measurable, enterprise‑wide impact. 
 
**Locations** 
Stanford Health Care 
 
**What you will do**

* Maintain continuous alignment with defined organizational and departmental strategic business objectives in conjunction with leadership.
* Direct and ensure the efficient operation of day-to-day activities of the team and ensure competency of all staff.
* Supports and partners on Change Management, Training and Communications activities as needed for effective performance improvement and project management.
* Act in an advisory capacity to all Supply Chain divisions, programs, staff and leaders.
* Provide expertise, guidance and training on Performance Improvement and Project Management best practices.
* Apply LEAN/Six Sigma principles and methods to identify waste reduction and performance optimization opportunities across Supply Chain operations.
* Implement, oversee and continuously improve Supply Chain systems, processes and standard work to drive the efficient management of operations across Logistics, Sourcing, Procurement, Business Office, Resiliency, Sustainability, Data Management and other functions.
* Build, develop and grow business relationships with Supply Chain’s key stakeholders and partners including but not limited to the Interventional Platform, A/P, Pharmacy, and IT.
* Lead cross-departmental initiatives, establishing strong governance, communication, and accountability to deliver progress measurable through mutually agreed KPIs.
* Align and collaborate with the enterprise Performance Improvement team and Stanford Operating System (SOS).
* Lead the implementation of programs and/or projects as assigned by the Administrative Director.

**Education Qualifications**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree in a work-related discipline/field from an accredited college or university.
* Relevant experience in lieu of degree may be considered. Relevant experience in lieu of degree is in addition to the experience requirements for this position.

**Experience Qualifications**

* Seven (7) years of progressively responsible and directly related work experience.

new_roles.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53235
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring an Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence for our highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and discipline. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Associate Director/Director of Operational Excellence runs our site MDI (managing for daily improvements) OpEx, continuous improvement programs, and all site PMO operations owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio while coordinating cross-functional projects. They build the operating rhythm that turns discrete functions into one aligned site team as the site scales to six suites, and owns the site’s strategy, execution, and culture discipline planning. Lead executive-level investigations and special initiatives as project/program lead, absorbing crisis response so operational leaders can stay focused on daily management.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Run site MDI including ownership of the Tier 6 site critical issue forum, ensuring cross-functional blockers are surfaced and resolved quickly

* Establish and sustain the site's cadence of daily, weekly, and monthly forums so issues are raised and resolved at the right level

* Lead OpEx and continuous improvement programs, building and prioritizing a CI project pipeline and delivering realized savings

* Lead all site PMO activities, owning the site project register and deciding how work is staffed and prioritized across the project portfolio, coordinating cross-functional projects and site initiatives and driving on-time delivery

* Own site strategy, execution, and rigor planning for culture translating strategic priorities into a disciplined, trackable execution plan across the site

* Own MDI and all standard work initiatives site-wide, ensuring consistent methodology and application across every function and suite

* Own site-wide implementation of lean principles building and driving the phased adoption roadmap across leadership, suites, and functions, from initial leadership alignment through daily floor-level practice

* Own site business analytics building and maintaining the reporting, dashboards, and KPI infrastructure that drive MDI, CI prioritization, and Site Leadership Team decision-making

* Co-lead the monthly finance/business review with finance operations, reconciling cost and capital needs against the site's financial plan

* Coach leaders and teams in Lean and problem-solving methods and build an OpEx culture across the site

* Embed MDI and OpEx practices as suites come online so new suites start up with the site's operating standards

* Partner with manufacturing, quality, technical services, technical operations, supply chain, and Finance as a member of the site leadership team

* Embed the digital and connected plant model in site MDI, using real-time data and digital tools for daily management and escalation

* Own the site's multi-year operational efficiency roadmap, driving leaner operations and delivering year-over-year efficiency gains

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing OpEx team; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Own a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Own these function's OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function
 

 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in engineering, life sciences, business or related technical field
* MBA & PMP certification preferred

* + Associate Director: 10+ years of operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 5+ years of progressive leadership

* + Director: 12+ years in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or manufacturing operations or biopharmaceuticals including 7+ years of progressive leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$150,800.00 - $292,700.00

new_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation (REMOTE)
new_roles.description:
**Job Summary:** 
 
The **Director of Operational Excellence and Implementation** provides strategic leadership and execution support for priority operational initiatives in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer and Operations leaders. This role translates organizational priorities into actionable implementation plans, leads assigned cross-functional initiatives, improves operational processes, and drives sustainable improvements in how work is performed.

The Director leads efforts to move initiatives from strategy through execution by developing implementation plans, establishing timelines and accountability, coordinating cross-functional activities, identifying risks and barriers, measuring progress, and providing clear visibility to leadership. The role also partners with teams to evaluate and redesign processes, strengthen procedures and documentation, improve cross-training and operational continuity, and identify opportunities to enhance efficiency through technology, automation, and self-service.

This role requires demonstrated experience leading operational improvement initiatives, managing complex projects, influencing across teams, and successfully implementing change. Success in this role requires strong strategic thinking, project execution, problem-solving, communication, and relationship-building skills, along with the ability to drive accountability and deliver measurable results.

This role follows a hybrid work arrangement, with the majority of time worked remotely and periodic in-office requirements in our downtown Chicago office.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Implementation and Project Coordination** **(40%)**

* **Develop and maintain implementation plans, timelines, milestones, responsibilities, and action items for priority Operations initiatives.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate activities across teams and follow up on commitments, deliverables, and outstanding actions.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Track project progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and issues requiring leadership attention.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Prepare concise status updates and other progress reporting for the COO and appropriate leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned cross-functional Operations initiatives from planning through implementation, working with department leaders to establish accountability, resolve barriers, and deliver agreed upon outcomes.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Facilitate working sessions to clarify responsibilities, resolve implementation issues, and move work from discussion to action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Partner with Operations leaders to advance agreed priorities, clarify responsibilities, and strengthen accountability while maintaining departmental ownership of ongoing operations.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Process Improvement (30%)**

* **Review and document selected operational processes and workflows.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Work with staff to identify unnecessary steps, manual work, duplication, unclear handoffs, and other opportunities for improvement.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop practical recommendations to simplify workflows, improve consistency, and strengthen operational effectiveness.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Lead assigned process improvement initiatives in partnership with department leaders, including implementation and evaluation of results.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help develop and maintain standard operating procedures and other operational documentation.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthen cross-training and backup coverage for critical processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify appropriate opportunities to improve workflows through technology, automation, and self-service.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Operational Change and Coordination (20%)**

* **Lead or coordinate implementation of assigned process, technology, and organizational changes within Operations, in partnership with the responsible department leaders.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Coordinate operational activities associated with selected technology implementations and other modernization initiatives.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help ensure changes are supported by appropriate documentation, communications, training, and follow-up.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Bring together the appropriate staff and leaders when work crosses departmental boundaries.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Help clarify responsibilities and handoffs when ownership is unclear.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identify implementation barriers and work with the appropriate leaders to resolve or escalate them.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor recently implemented changes and help address issues affecting adoption or effectiveness.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* **Measurement and Reporting (10%)**

* **Establish practical measures for selected initiatives and operational improvements.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Develop baseline information when needed to evaluate the impact of a change.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Monitor whether implemented changes are achieving expected results.**
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Use available operational data and staff or candidate feedback to identify areas requiring additional attention.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Provide the COO with clear visibility into progress, risks, workload, and outstanding decisions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Initial Focus Areas:**

*(Initial assignments are expected to include)*

* **Supporting implementation of priority Operations initiatives within DANB’s strategic roadmap.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Establishing a consistent approach for planning, tracking, and reporting major Operations projects.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting process improvement in selected candidate-facing areas, including Document Review, Client Services, and Certification Operations.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Identifying opportunities to reduce manual work and improve workflows through process redesign and technology.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strengthening procedures, documentation, cross-training, and backup coverage.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Supporting implementation of approved changes to Operations roles, responsibilities, and processes.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Skills and Attributes:**

* **Strong organizational and project implementation skills with consistent attention to follow-through.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Ability to organize complex work into clear plans, responsibilities, timelines, and next steps.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.**
 --------------------------------------------------------
* **Effective facilitator who can help teams move from discussion to decisions and action.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Strong written and verbal communication skills.**
 ---------------------------------------------------
* **Collaborative and skilled at building productive relationships across teams and functions.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Able to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and recognize when issues require escalation.**
 ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated ability to influence leaders and teams, establish accountability, and drive initiatives to completion without direct supervisory authority.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Practical approach to process improvement that avoids unnecessary complexity or bureaucracy.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Comfortable learning new systems, technologies, and operational processes.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Education & Qualifications:**

* **Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience required.**
 ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Minimum 8 years of progressively responsible experience in operations, project implementation, process improvement, or business operations, including demonstrated responsibility for leading complex, cross-functional initiatives required.**
 -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Demonstrated success leading initiatives from planning through implementation, including delivering measurable operational improvements.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience reviewing and improving business processes and workflows.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience supporting technology-enabled operational change preferred.**
 --------------------------------------------------------------------------
* **Experience in certification, credentialing, assessment, associations, nonprofits, healthcare, or another regulated environment is preferred.**
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Physical Demands:**

Required to sit for extended periods of time; may need to walk or stand in the course of work as well as light (20-30 lbs.) to medium (30-40 lbs.) levels of lifting of supplies and/or equipment.

**Work Environment:**

Work performed in an office environment, either onsite or offsite; periodic travel to be expected (<10%)

new_roles.title: Sr. Director Operations
new_roles.description:
**What makes DHL great?** Our People! We know each employee’s individual contributions make us the #1 Express Delivery and Logistics Company in the world.

***Distinguished as No. 1 World’s Best Workplace™ by Great Place to Work and Fortune Magazine***

DHL Express is committed to maintaining an environment that empowers every team member to make the greatest possible impact on our business. Our culture is about personal commitment – to our business, to each other and to our global communities. DHL is dedicated to being a great place to work. In addition to competitive compensation packages, our employees enjoy a range of programs, services and benefits that bring the best to their personal lives.

**Start YOUR career with DHL today…**

The **Sr. Director Operations** is responsible for providing strategic input and leading the implementation of the Courier and Pick-up & Delivery strategy. This role ensures the safe, secure, timely, and accurate transportation and delivery of mail, parcels, small packages, and legal documents between locations, in alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, corporate guidelines, and policies.

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Provide input to develop Couriers, Pick-up & Delivery operations strategy to deliver effective collection, transportation, and delivery of parcels while maintaining exceptional service quality and customer satisfaction.
* Plan, organize and control preparation of annual business plans, operational budgets, workforce planning, and resource allocation for delivery operations.
* Provide expertise, coaching, and leadership to frontline managers and supervisors to ensure execution of daily operational activities, achievement of performance targets, and development of future leaders.
* Manage and control service point operations to enable efficient collection, handling, and distribution of shipments while maintaining compliance with operational standards.
* Manage and control scheduling of transportation capacity, traffic volumes, route structures, and delivery resources to maximize productivity and service performance.
* Lead a workforce of more than 1,000 employees across multiple facilities, fostering a culture of accountability, engagement, safety, and operational excellence.
* Demonstrate strong knowledge and experience operating in unionized environments, including labor relations, contract interpretation, grievance resolution, workforce planning, and effective collaboration with union leadership.
* Oversee large independent contractor (IC) networks and transportation providers, ensuring contractual compliance, operational performance, cost management, and service reliability.
* Drive operational expense (OPEX) management through disciplined financial oversight, productivity initiatives, route optimization, and continuous improvement programs to achieve profitability objectives.
* Partner closely with Network Operations, Gateway Operations, Brokerage, Customs, Aviation, and Commercial teams to ensure seamless execution of customer commitments and network requirements.
* Deploy structured approaches to manage operational procedures including shipment processing, sorting, loading/unloading, documentation, scanning compliance, manifests, secure handling, and custody control.
* Implement reporting standards, performance metrics, and operational dashboards to provide visibility into service performance, cost drivers, productivity, and customer experience measures.
* Anticipate changes in customer demand, economic conditions, labor markets, and transportation trends to proactively adjust operational strategies and resource requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation, delivery, and customer service solutions through process redesign, technology implementation, and network optimization.
* Monitor operational performance and implement continuous improvement initiatives focused on service quality, productivity, safety, employee engagement, and cost control.
* Lead multiple delivery bases and service centers across geographically diverse markets, ensuring consistent execution of operational standards and business objectives.
* Champion safety, security, and compliance programs while maintaining adherence to company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
* Build strong relationships with key customers, local business leaders, and internal stakeholders to support growth initiatives and enhance the overall customer experience.
* Drive organizational change initiatives, workforce transformation efforts, and strategic projects across the region while maintaining high levels of employee engagement and operational performance.

**Skills/Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree required.
* 8+ years of experience in operations and leadership roles.
* Demonstrated experience in budgetary management and financial accountability.
* Strong background in business and operations management, including managing complex operational environments.
* Experience leading courier, Pick-up & Delivery, dock, and transportation operations.
* Proven ability to lead change management and operational improvement initiatives.
* Strong strategic planning and execution capabilities.
* Demonstrated experience in stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration.
* Proven leadership experience managing a department or business unit comprising multiple teams, including Managers and/or Team Leaders.
* Strong ability to lead, develop, and influence leaders and teams to achieve business and operational objectives.
* Experience establishing priorities, managing resources, and driving performance across multiple operational functions.
* Demonstrated ability to drive employee engagement, foster an inclusive and high-performing culture, and develop strategies that strengthen employee experience, retention, and organizational effectiveness.

**Employee Benefits & Incentives**

DHL Express benefits and incentive offerings are designed to reflect a substantial experience for both employees and their dependents during their career and life journey. The specifics will vary, but wherever you join and in whatever role, you'll find our benefits and rewards are among the best in the industry They include:

* Competitive Pay - Salary Range New Jersey $187,950- $250,600
* Bonus/Incentive Programs
* Retirement Savings – 401K with company match
* Medical, Dental, Vision, well-being programs
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Generous Paid Time Off – Starting at 4 Weeks (PT/FT)
* Paid Leave
* Employee Discount Program
* Employee Assistance & Work Life Program
* Outstanding training opportunities

*DHL is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status,* *or any other protected characteristic. The EEO is the Law poster is available here:* *https://www.eeoc.gov/employers/eeo-law-poster*

*We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to* *participate* *in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.* *Please contact us to request accommodation.*

Job Description
 
 
Director, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Strategy & Operations
 
 
Position Description
 
 
The Director, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Strategy & Operations is a key leadership role responsible for shaping and advancing the strategic and operational priorities of the U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases Business Unit.
 
Reporting directly to the SVP, U.S. Vaccines & Infectious Diseases, this individual will serve as a strategic thought partner to the SVP and Leadership Team, translating business strategy into action, driving alignment across priorities, and enabling disciplined execution. The role requires a strong balance of strategic thinking, operational excellence, influence, and change leadership, with the ability to navigate ambiguity, connect across the organization, and accelerate progress against the BU's most important priorities.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities:** 

* Lead the BU strategic planning and operating process, including annual priority setting, Trimester planning and tracking, and ongoing assessment of progress against key objectives.
* Partner with the SVP and Leadership Team to translate strategy into action, identifying priorities, surfacing opportunities and risks, and driving alignment and accountability across the organization.
* Lead high-priority, cross-functional initiatives that advance BU strategy, transformation, and organizational capabilities, including evolving commercial capabilities, new ways of working, AI, and other emerging business priorities.
* Drive leadership effectiveness and decision-making by shaping and facilitating Leadership Team meetings, leader forums, strategic planning sessions, and other key business forums that enable alignment and action.
* Shape BU communications and engagement strategy, ensuring business priorities, strategic direction, and key messages are translated into clear and compelling communications across the organization, including Town Halls and other leadership forums.
* Partner with Leadership Team sponsors to advance talent, culture, and organizational priorities, including Talent & Culture working groups, employee development initiatives, and efforts to strengthen organizational capability and engagement.
* Partner across key financial planning processes, including forecasting, Profit Plan, and investor relations connecting strategic priorities with financial considerations and partnering across Finance and business stakeholders to enable informed decision-making.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen BU effectiveness, simplify ways of working, build organizational capabilities, and accelerate execution of strategic priorities.

**Required Experience:** 

* Bachelor's degree required.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in marketing, sales, market access, strategy and operations, marketing support, within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
* Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities, including the ability to assess complex business challenges, identify strategic choices, and develop clear recommendations.
* Proven ability to influence and lead without direct authority across complex, matrixed organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders, with the courage to challenge thinking, bring an independent point of view, and constructively navigate differing perspectives.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity and evolving priorities, quickly create structure from white space, and move work forward with sound judgment and learning agility.
* Demonstrated ability to prioritize competing demands, maintain focus on the highest-impact work, and align teams around clear priorities.
* Ability to inspire, motivate, mentor, and align others around a shared vision and clear priorities, with or without direct reporting relationships.
* Strong balance of strategic orientation and operational discipline, with the ability to move seamlessly between long-term priorities and near-term execution.
* Demonstrated ability to connect insights and priorities across functions and levels of the organization, bringing an enterprise perspective while maintaining focus on BU objectives.

**Preferred Experience and Skills:** 

* Vaccines and/or Infectious Diseases experience.
* Experience supporting or leading strategy and operations within a complex commercial organization.
* Experience leading enterprise or cross-functional transformation, capability-building, or change initiatives.

**Required Skills:** 
Accountability, Active Listening, Adaptability, Business Alignment, Business Operations, Data-Driven Decision Making, Developing Proposals, Influencing Without Authority, Influential Leadership, Market Access, Marketing, Market Research, Oncology Marketing, Pharmaceutical Industry, Pharmaceutics, Relationship Building, Results-Oriented, Sound Judgment, Strategic Planning, Strategic Recommendations, Strategic Thinking, Vaccinology

identity_held_roles.title: Director, Production Operations
identity_held_roles.description:
**Sierra Space Careers:**
At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.
 
 
Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.
 
 
Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.
 
 
We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.
 
 
**About The Role**
Sierra Space is scaling from development programs into high-rate, repeatable production across a diversified portfolio of military and commercial systems, including satellites and spacecraft, propulsion systems, solar power systems, and the Dream Chaser spaceplane. As Director, Production Operations based in Madison, Wisconsin, you will play a critical role in executing the production strategy for propulsion development and manufacturing, building the operational systems required to deliver hardware at pace, at quality, and at cost.
 
 
This is an execution-focused leadership role for a proven operations professional with expertise in propulsion systems. Reporting to the Vice President, Production, you will lead manufacturing and assembly operations for propulsion product lines and additional enterprise products within Sierra Space's Madison facility. You will drive standardization of production processes, implement data-driven manufacturing systems, and build high-performing teams capable of scaling propulsion output while maintaining quality and efficiency. You will partner closely with Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, and Program Management to ensure production readiness and on-time delivery of critical propulsion systems for space and defense applications.
 
 
**About You**
Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.
 
 
We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead manufacturing and assembly operations for propulsion product lines, including day-to-day oversight of production floor activities, scheduling, and workflow management at the Madison, WI facility.
* Execute production strategy to scale propulsion manufacturing from development programs into repeatable, high-rate production with a focus on throughput, yield, and cost efficiency.
* Standardize propulsion production processes and workflows to create consistent, repeatable, high-quality build operations aligned with enterprise-wide best practices.
* Support capacity planning and facility buildout efforts for propulsion manufacturing, including layout optimization, equipment installation, and production line commissioning.
* Drive vertical integration initiatives by standing up and maturing internal propulsion manufacturing capabilities, including additive manufacturing, machining, assembly, and test operations for propulsion components and systems.
* Implement and mature manufacturing execution systems (MES) and production data infrastructure to enable traceability, repeatability, and real-time visibility into propulsion manufacturing performance.
* Establish and maintain production operating rhythm through KPIs, dashboards, and review cadences focused on cycle time, yield, throughput, labor efficiency, on-time delivery, and cost for propulsion production.
* Apply lean manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) to identify and eliminate production inefficiencies, reduce waste, and improve quality in propulsion operations.
* Collaborate with Propulsion Engineering and Product Assurance to drive design-for-manufacturing (DFM) and design-for-test (DFT) into propulsion product development and support new product introduction (NPI) activities.
* Partner across Supply Chain, Engineering, Quality, Facilities, Security, and Program Management to ensure aligned production readiness, material availability, and execution against propulsion program schedules.
* Manage production budgets for propulsion operations and analyze manufacturing costs to implement cost-saving measures that maintain quality standards and support financial goals.
* Lead and develop production management teams at the Madison facility, including supervisors, engineers, and technicians, fostering collaboration and accountability while upholding company values and a culture of operational excellence.
* Ensure compliance with industry-specific production standards, safety regulations, and quality management systems (ISO, AS9100, GMP, etc.) applicable to aerospace and propulsion manufacturing operations.
* Represent propulsion production operations in cross-functional forums and communicate status, risks, and mitigation plans to executive leadership and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory bodies.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree).
* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, or operations roles in complex technical industries, with a significant portion in leadership positions.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required
* Proven track record of successfully managing large teams and complex production projects in high-rate manufacturing environments.
* Strong background in manufacturing processes, assembly & integration, and operational execution for complex electromechanical or aerospace systems, with emphasis on propulsion systems preferred.
* Demonstrated experience implementing and scaling production operations, including process standardization, workflow optimization, and capacity planning.
* Experience with data-driven manufacturing systems, MES, and production management processes, including OKR development and performance tracking.
* Knowledge of design-for-manufacturing (DFM) principles and ability to collaborate with engineering teams to optimize product designs for production.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and drive operational excellence in fast-paced, highly technical environments.
* Expertise in continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma) with proven ability to identify and eliminate production inefficiencies.
* Strong financial acumen with demonstrated ability to manage production budgets, analyze manufacturing costs, and implement cost-saving measures.
* In-depth knowledge of industry-specific production standards, safety regulations, and quality management systems (ISO, AS9100, GMP, etc.).
* Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to represent production interests effectively to executive leadership and external stakeholders.
* Ability to uphold and model company values while holding others accountable and fostering a culture of operational excellence.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in propulsion manufacturing and test operations, including liquid or hybrid rocket engines, thrusters, or propulsion subsystems.
* Familiarity with additive manufacturing (3D printing) for propulsion components, including metal printing processes and post-processing.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, satellite, launch, or high-rate hardware manufacturing across both military and commercial product lines.
* Experience with vertically integrated manufacturing capabilities such as propulsion, fluid systems, PCBAs, structures, or integrated vehicle production.
* Experience with spacecraft or satellite integration and production.
* Familiarity with classified manufacturing and secure production operations.
* Experience implementing lean or continuous-improvement frameworks at scale in production environments.
* Experience with automated manufacturing, MES implementation, or production data systems.
* Experience leading organizational change initiatives specific to production environments, including technology implementation, process redesign, and workforce development.
* Experience building and scaling production teams during periods of rapid company growth.
* Master's degree in engineering, operations, business, or a related field.

Compensation:
 
 
Pay Range:
 
 
$164,513.00 - $226,205.00
 
 
Your actual base compensation will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on job-related knowledge and skills, education, experience, internal equity and market competitiveness.
 
 
**IMPORTANT NOTICE:**
This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. Citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance.  The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.
 
 
**Elevate Your Career**
At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.
 
 
We also offer a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, and more.
 
 
Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.
 
 
*Application Deadline: This role will remain posted until a qualified pool of candidates is*
*identified.*
***Please note: Sierra Space does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to Sierra Space team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of Sierra Space, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.***
Sierra Space Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

identity_held_roles.title: Plant Manager
identity_held_roles.description:
Job ID: 530933

Ash Grove is a CRH company with a legacy dating back to 1882. We combine technical expertise, safety and customer-focused solutions to deliver reliable performance for our customers. We manufacture and supply high-performance, advanced cementitious materials for the most demanding construction and infrastructure needs. With more than 2,000 people across 60 locations in the United States and Canada, we support a wide range of applications, from major infrastructure projects to the development and refurbishment of residential and non-residential buildings that support everyday life, from highways and bridges to schools and commercial buildings.

To learn more about us go to www.ashgrove.com

**Job Summary**

The Plant Manager plans, coordinates, and supervises the production operations, hazardous waste fuel program, maintenance activities, quality and safety programs, and other related functions involved in plant operations. This position incorporates directives provided by corporate management into policies and procedures to maintain standards and schedules. The position exercises direct or indirect supervision over a large number of employees.

**Job Location**

* This role will work out of our plant in Louisville, NE.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Promote and follow all plant safety guidelines.
* Conducts meetings with plant staff personnel to communicate, coordinate and discuss plant operations.
* Monitors, inspects, and reviews all plant activities.
* Ensures production schedule corresponds with sales forecasts.
* Assists in investigating customer and quality problems and concerns.
* Meets with government agencies and community groups concerning plant activities to ensure compliance with environmental regulations, policies, and standards.
* Prepares regular reports regarding plant production operations.
* Attends Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA) training for waste-derived fuel activities.
* Promotes effective job performance through motivation, goals, and providing feedback.
* Promotes the safety program, compliance with safety standards, and participates in safety meetings.
* Establishes plant standards, short-term goals, and long-term strategic plans for production, maintenance, and improvements.
* Discusses new products, equipment, and ideas with staff and vendors.
* Analyzes plant costs and explore methods to improve productivity cost-effectively.
* Uses technology to develop a continuous improvement plan for the plant.
* Troubleshoots various problems and performance barriers.

**Job Requirements**

* Ability to read, write, and understand warning labels, instructions, signs, etc.
* Minimum 4 Year - Bachelors Degree in engineering, chemistry, natural sciences, business administration, or closely related field.
* Professional Engineer (PE) preferred
* Ability to develop and deliver effective presentations
* Ability to make decisions and solve problems with high attention to detail and accuracy
* Ability to make sound independent judgments regularly
* Ability to effectively coach and deliver constructive feedback
* Ability to inspire and develop staff
* Proficient in effective negotiation skills in business and construction contracts
* Proficient in Microsoft Office365
* Ability to effectively use computers for general word processing, spreadsheets, presentations, e-mail, internet, and customized company programs.
* Ability to communicate the company's vision into actionable goals and contributions for plant personnel.
* Ability to network with industry professionals, consultants, vendors, suppliers, regulators, and the community.
* Knowledge of safety and environmental health regulations.
* Knowledge of cement chemistry, physical testing, and concrete performance.
* Knowledge of various systems for cement manufacturing (crushing, grinding, pyro processing, chemistry).
* Ability to work from general policies and procedures.
* Ability to refer to supervisor when clarification or interpretation of the organizational policy

**What CRH Offers You**

* Highly competitive base pay
* Comprehensive medical, dental and disability benefits programs
* Group retirement savings program
* Health and wellness programs
* An inclusive culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion

**About CRH**

CRH has a long and proud heritage. We are a collection of hundreds of family businesses, regional companies and large enterprises that together form the CRH family. CRH operates in a decentralized, diversified structure that allows you to work in a small company environment while having the career opportunities of a large international organization.

If you’re up for a rewarding challenge, we invite you to take the first step and apply today! Once you click apply now, you will be brought to our official employment application. Please complete your online profile and it will be sent to the hiring manager. Our system allows you to view and track your status 24 hours a day. Thank you for your interest!

Ash Grove Cement, a CRH Company, is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer.

EOE/Vet/Disability

CRH is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

AI tools may be used in certain stages of the employment lifecycle, such as candidate review; however, all final employment decisions will be made by a person.

identity_held_roles.description:
**Title:**
Plant Manager
 
 
**Company:**
Manufacturing Group
 
 
**Location:**
Tewksbury, MA area
 
 
**Reports to:**
CEO
 
 
**Direct reports:**
Production, Maintenance, Sanitation, and Warehouse/Shipping leaders
 
 
**About The Company**
Our client is a manufacturer in the Merrimack Valley of Massachusetts that produces high-quality, value-added, hand-crafted products.
 
 
They have roughly 400 employees in the US and a workforce that spans down the East Coast, but the majority of the workforce is in MA.
 
 
**The Opportunity**
The Plant Manager owns the day-to-day performance of the company's Massachusetts production facility, with full accountability for safety, quality, output, cost, and people. This is a hands-on, on-the-floor leadership role in a fast-paced, high-mix, labor-intensive operation.
 
 
The right leader will bring structure and discipline to the plant while keeping the craftsmanship and customer responsiveness that set the business apart. You will partner closely with the executive team, Quality, Continuous Improvement, Sales, and Supply Chain, and you will play a visible role in executing the value creation plan.
 
 
**Key Responsibilities**
**Safety and Operations**

* Lead a strong safety culture with clear accountability, training, and incident prevention; drive OSHA compliance and reduce recordables
* Ensure full compliance with regulations and standards
* Maintain control, sanitation, and traceability standards across all lines

**Operations and Performance**

* Deliver daily, weekly, and monthly production plans that meet customer service, on-time-in-full, and quality targets
* Own plant KPIs, including yield, labor productivity, throughput, OEE, scrap/giveaway, and cost.
* Manage a high-SKU, customized product mix with frequent changeovers and short lead times
* Partner with Supply Chain and Sales on capacity planning, scheduling, and new product launches

**Cost and Financial Management**

* Build and manage the plant operating budget and labor model; identify and deliver cost savings
* Recommend and execute capital projects, including automation and equipment that reduce labor dependency

**Continuous Improvement**

* Embed lean manufacturing tools (5S, standard work, root cause analysis, visual management, tiered daily huddles) in partnership with the Continuous Improvement function
* Use data to identify losses and drive sustainable improvements in yield and efficiency

**People and Culture**

* Lead, develop, and hold accountable a team of supervisors and leads across multiple shifts
* Attract, train, and retain a diverse hourly workforce; build bench strength and succession
* Communicate clearly and visibly on the floor; set a tone of respect, ownership, and teamwork

**Maintenance and Facility**

* Oversee preventive maintenance, equipment reliability, and facility upkeep to minimize downtime

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related field, or equivalent experience
* 8+ years of manufacturing experience, including 3+ years as a Plant Manager, Operations Manager, or Production Manager with full P&L or plant-level accountability
* Proven track record of improving safety, yield, labor productivity, and cost in a high-mix, labor-intensive environment
* Hands-on lean manufacturing or continuous improvement experience
* Ability to work on-site north of Boston, MA

**Preferred**

* Experience in a high-growth company
* Experience introducing automation into a manual or semi-automated operation
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt; certification
* Bilingual English/Spanish or experience leading a multilingual workforce

**Leadership Profile and First-Year Success**
**What We're Looking For In The Leader**

* Floor-first: visible, approachable, and present on every shift
* Accountable and data-driven: sets clear expectations and measures results
* A builder of people who develops supervisors into leaders
* Calm and decisive in a fast-moving, customer-driven environment
* Comfortable with the pace and expectations of PE ownership

**What Success Looks Like In The First 12 Months**

* Measurable improvement in safety and performance
* A consistent daily management system with KPI boards and tiered huddles in place
* Documented gains in yield, labor productivity, and on-time delivery
* A stable, engaged supervisory team with reduced hourly turnover
* A prioritized capital and automation roadmap aligned with leadership

identity_held_roles.title: Plant Manager I
identity_held_roles.description:
This position leads all plant operations for a70+ employee, 2 shift, manufacturing site. This leader ensures day-to-day operations are delivered with the aligned objectives of safety-first mindset, customer satisfaction along with growing and developing the leaders within the facility. This position also plays a critical role in developing and executing capital project plans for the facility to enable continuous improvement and growth in market share.

This full-time position reports directly to region General Manager and is located at Liberty Packaging’s manufacturing plant in Houston, Texas

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Directly lead and supervise a team of direct reports to deliver major site functions across manufacturing, shipping, maintenance, and scheduling.
* Own end-to-end performance for the facility to meet KPIs in the areas of Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery. Establish, measure, and monitor performance across facility and root cause performance issues. Develop and deploy plans to drive improvements in manufacturing processes to ensure superior product quality, reduced cycle times, lead times, and minimize overall manufacturing costs.
* Provide day-to-day leadership for manufacturing team decision-making in the areas of production, labor, material costs, design, and production scheduling.
* In partnership with Continuous Improvement function, guide leaders and front-line staff through the identification and deployment of continuous improvement initiatives with an impact on key performance indicators.
* Ensure the right talent and capabilities are in place to meet strategic objectives; accountable for establishing goals, managing performance, and developing teams to ensure short- and long-range objectives are achieved
* Establish a two-way communication & engagement culture to ensure all plant employees are clear on plant performance and connection to business performance, including KPIs.
* Lead key change initiatives across the plant in partnership with regional and functional support systems (e.g., continuous improvement, engineering, human resources, sales, etc.)
* Lead the successful identification, business case design, and execution of capital projects in partnership with functional teams and executive leadership. Ensure multi-year capital plans support market growth and customer delivery
* Ensure employee relations stay connected with open and continuous dialogue
* Develop and grow community engagement presence by representing plant locally in key activities and through execution of frequent employee and community engagement activities
* Own direct P&L responsibility for plant site
* Provide leadership by connecting and being visible to all three shifts daily
* Other duties, as assigned

**Required Education, Experience And Skills**

* Bachelors’ degree and 7+ years manufacturing experience OR 10+ years manufacturing industry experience in lieu of education
* 5+ years people leadership experience
* Experience analyzing downtime, production, and financial variance trends, and identifying actions to deliver expected performance
* Previous experience developing and managing a budget, forecasting, and monitoring results
* Experience with identifying and executing capital projects to drive improvement against KPIs
* Demonstrated experience with organizational effectiveness, operations management, and a proven track record of achieving results
* Experience developing and presenting information to multiple levels of the organization from front-line to executive leadership
* Superior time management, attention to detail, verbal and written communication skills, decision-making, and organization skills
* Excellent computer skills required, including Microsoft Word and Excel skills.
* Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit

**Preferred Education, Experience And Skills**

* Previous experience with Amtech / CTI or Kiwi
* Previous experience with ERP systems
* Previous experience in corrugated or paper manufacturing
* Lean and / or Continuous Improvement certifications
* Bilingual English / Spanish

**Compensation & Benefits**

The starting base salary range for this position is $110,078 - $137,598 per year plus eligibility in annual bonus program. The compensation posted is the anticipated pay for the position at the time of the posting. We may pay above or below posted amount based on several factors, including, but not limited to education and/or certifications, skills, experience, or work location. Some positions may qualify for additional compensation in the form of bonuses or deferred compensation options.

At LDI, we are pleased to provide employees with a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision insurance options; paid time off; 10 paid holidays; 401(k) plus company matching and annual discretionary profit sharing; flexible spending and health savings account options; life and disability insurance; tuition assistance; wellness and mental health resources, and financial advising services. Eligibility in benefit programs is based on hours worked per week.

**Physical Requirements**

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

* Regular sitting, standing, and walking throughout the day to accomplish tasks
* Manual and finger dexterity used regularly with some repetitive finger motions
* Ability to work in front of a computer screen for long periods of time
* Specific vision abilities include close and distance vision; able to identify colors, small letters, and numbers; hand/eye coordination, depth perception and able to adjust focus
* Hearing and speaking
* Other conditions may include frequent reaching, stretching, pushing, pulling, pinching, grasping, and gripping.

**About Our Company**

Comprised of multiple companies with headquarters in New Hope, Minnesota, Liberty Diversified International (LDI) is a privately held company employing more than 1,900 individuals across our manufacturing facilities, production facilities and core business operations in Minnesota, Iowa, Nebraska, Illinois, Mississippi, Texas, Arizona, Virginia, California, and Mexico. With deep roots in the corrugated box manufacturing industry, we operate in the core markets of paper, packaging, workplace products, corrugated plastics and building products.

Since 1918, our values – Caring, Innovation, Trust and Excellence – have guided our day-to-day activities. We believe that when our employees are aligned with these values, we create superior service and solutions for our customers. The LDI family of companies includes Liberty Packaging, Liberty Paper, Liberty Plastics (Custom Solutions and Quarrix Building Products) and Safco.

Liberty Diversified International is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions without regard to race, color, sex, religion, age, creed, sexual orientation, national origin, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

****Plant Manager at FRC, a Clarience Technologies Company****
****Location: Nesconset, NY****
****﻿****
****﻿New York Annual Salary Range: $145,000 - $175,000 USD****
****﻿****
Position Summary
 
 
****FRC****
, a Clarience Technologies company, is a leading manufacturer and innovator of firefighting and emergency response technologies serving fire apparatus OEMs, dealers, and fire departments throughout North America. FRC develops industry-leading solutions including fire apparatus controls, pressure governors, instrumentation, LED scene lighting, electronic control systems, and FoamPro® foam injection and proportioning systems.
 
 
The
****Plant Manager****
leads a manufacturing operation of approximately 80 employees across 2 shifts and is responsible for Production, Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, and Facilities. This role is accountable for driving a world-class safety culture, delivering revenue and profitability objectives, achieving quality and operational performance targets, and leading continuous improvement initiatives across the organization.
 
 
As a key member of the leadership team, the Plant Manager will develop and execute operational strategies that support growth, innovation, customer satisfaction, and operational excellence.
 
 
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Safety Leadership
* Champion and drive a proactive safety culture.
* Ensure achievement of targeted safety metrics.
* Lead safety initiatives, investigations and corrective actions.
* Operational Leadership
* Lead Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities and Quality functions.
* Provide weekly revenue forecasts and operational updates.
* Drive Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen and continuous improvement efforts.
* Support new product introductions and manufacturing readiness.
* Financial Management
* Manage labor, variable overhead and fixed overhead costs.
* Achieve gross margin objectives and operational budgets.
* Lead cost reduction and productivity improvement initiatives.
* Quality Management
* Develop and implement the Quality Management System.
* Drive quality metrics, corrective actions and continuous improvement.
* Ensure customer quality requirements are achieved.
* Leadership and Talent Development
* Lead supervisors and functional managers.
* Develop organizational capability and succession plans.
* Partner with HR on employee development and workforce planning.

**Managerial Responsibilities**

* Directly manages departmental supervisors and functional leaders within Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, and Quality. Procurement and Scheduling report directly to the President and are not part of this role’s reporting structure.

****Competencies****

* Leadership and team development
* Financial and business acumen
* Operational excellence mindset
* Strong communication and influence skills
* Data-driven decision making
* Problem solving and continuous improvement
* Integrity, accountability and results orientation

*****﻿*****
**\*We do not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, marital status, national origin, sexual orientation, age, disability, ancestry veteran status or any other status protected by law.**
**Requirements**
****Education and Experience****

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, Business or related field preferred.
* 7-10 years of progressive manufacturing leadership experience.
* Experience managing revenue, labor, overhead and gross margin performance.
* Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement experience required.

**Computer Skills**

* ERP/MRP systems
* Microsoft Office Suite
* Manufacturing reporting tools
* Workforce/timekeeping systems

identity_held_roles.description:
**Job Description**
**Description & Requirements**
**About AESC US LLC**
AESC is a global leader in the development and manufacturing of high-performance batteries for zero-emission electric vehicles and energy storage systems. Founded in Japan in 2007 and headquartered in Yokohama, AESC has been building manufacturing capabilities around the world in the U.S., U.K., Europe, Japan and China to serve key markets and leading customers locally for over 14 years. Today, AESC has become the partner of choice for the world's leading OEMs and energy storage providers in North America, Europe, and Asia. Its advanced technology powers over one million electric vehicles and provides more than 15GWh of installed capacity for battery energy systems in over 60 countries.
 
 
AESC is expanding its footprint in the United States, and the Blythewood Repack Operation supports the broader South Carolina production network. AESC is committed to our local communities where it is making its investments, creating jobs, and supporting local charities.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Senior Operations Manager provides comprehensive leadership of manufacturing operations, driving safe, reliable, efficient, and cost-effective production. This role is responsible for integrating production execution with workforce planning, material flow, equipment availability, quality performance, and operational readiness.
 
 
The successful candidate must possess a broad understanding of plant operations and demonstrate the ability to lead across functions rather than operate solely as a production manager.
 
 
****What You Will Do****

* Direct daily manufacturing operations across assigned shifts and production areas.
* Establish and execute production plans that align labor, equipment, materials, and customer delivery requirements.
* Manage operational KPIs including throughput, OEE, labor productivity, downtime, scrap, cost, and on-time delivery.
* Collaborate with Maintenance and Engineering to ensure equipment availability, preventive maintenance execution, and effective downtime response.
* Partner with Quality to manage manufacturing defects, process compliance, containment, and corrective actions.
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Logistics to maintain effective material flow, inventory accuracy, and production readiness.
* Lead production supervisors and team leaders, establishing clear expectations for attendance, timekeeping, staffing, overtime controls, and employee performance.
* Manage operating expenses, labor utilization, and production resource requirements.
* Promote a disciplined safety culture with EHS and enforce manufacturing operating standards.
* Support commissioning, production ramp-up, process stabilization, and future plant expansion.
* Develop staffing, succession, and workforce capability plans.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**
****What You Need****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Operations Management, Manufacturing, or a related discipline, or equivalent substantial manufacturing leadership experience.
* At least 10 years of progressive manufacturing experience, including five years in plant operations leadership.
* Demonstrated accountability for manufacturing performance, staffing, safety, cost, and cross-functional execution.
* Experience with ERP/MES systems, Lean manufacturing, and operational performance management.

****What is "Nice to Have"?****

* Automotive OEM or Tier 1 experience.
* Battery manufacturing experience.
* High-volume automated manufacturing experience.
* Plant launch or greenfield ramp-up experience.

****Travel Requirements****
20% International Travel
 
 
****What We Offer****
Welcome to AESC, where you'll have the opportunity to tackle the world's most fascinating challenges alongside exceptionally talented individuals who are driven to make a difference. We strive to ensure that our employees are well taken care of, enabling them to focus on their work and contribute to our collective mission.
 
 
**We Offer**

* Comprehensive compensation packages including a competitive salary and a rewarding bonus program.
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that fosters and encourages professional and personal development.
* Highly automated, clean, safe, and temperature-controlled production environment.
* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance.
* HSA and Flexible Spending Accounts.
* 401K with company match.
* Life Insurance (Company paid and additional voluntary life available).
* Paid Vacation and 14 Paid Holidays.
* Short-term and long-term disability coverage (Company Paid).
* Tuition reimbursement.

****Equal Employment Opportunity****
At AESC, we are committed to providing Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) to all individuals. We participate in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. Join us in our passion to design, manufacture, and sell high-performance products, contributing to a sustainable and zero-carbon emission future.
 
 
****Physical Requirements****
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable otherwise qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential job functions.
 
 

* Ability to stand, walk, and work on a concrete production floor for extended periods of time.
* Ability to read, write, speak, hear; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach and lift with hands and arms frequently throughout the day.
* Ability to wear all required PPE when working on the production floor.
* Required to occasionally lift, push, pull and/or move up to 10 pounds, and occasionally required to lift, push, pull and/or move up to 35 pounds.

****Work Environment****
The work environment is primarily a semi-automated/automated plant with a concrete floor and is characterized as climate controlled, moderate noise, and forklift traffic. The individual must be able to perform all essential functions as appropriate on the plant floor, in meetings, and with employees, management, customers and suppliers.
 
 
Candidate must perform the essential duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation efficiently and accurately, and without causing significant safety threat to self or others. The statements made herein are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this job classification. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive and inclusive list of all responsibilities, duties, and/or skills required of personnel so classified.
 
 
Hiring is contingent upon successful completion of a drug screen and background check, and verification of the candidate's eligibility to work in the United States. AESC US LLC is a drug-free workplace.

* **Director of Continuous Improvement**
* **Greater Charlotte Area**

A leading global industrial manufacturer is seeking a Director of Continuous Improvement to drive operational excellence, Lean transformation, and productivity improvements across multiple manufacturing facilities. Reporting directly to the C-suite, this high-impact leadership role will be responsible for deploying enterprise-wide continuous improvement strategies, developing Lean capabilities, and delivering measurable gains in safety, quality, delivery, productivity, and cost performance. If you're passionate about building high-performing operations, coaching teams, and leading large-scale Lean transformations, this is an outstanding opportunity to make a lasting impact within a growing international organization.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

* Lead the deployment of Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement strategies across multiple manufacturing sites.
 
 Champion the use of Lean methodologies including Kaizen, Value Stream Mapping, Standard Work, SMED, TPM, and Six Sigma tools.
* Support plant leadership teams in identifying and executing operational improvement opportunities.
* Coach and mentor Plant Managers, Operations Leaders, CI Managers, and Production Leaders.
* Develop Lean competencies throughout the organization through training, workshops, and hands-on coaching.
* Support facility footprint optimization, cost reduction programs, and operational strategy deployment.
* Pioneer the implementation of digital manufacturing and Smart Factory technologies.
* Ensure operational excellence principles are embedded into daily management systems and site culture.

:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related discipline,
* 10+ years of experience leading Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement initiatives within a manufacturing environment.
* 8+ years of experience applying Lean methodologies in high-volume industrial or automotive manufacturing operations.
* Proven experience driving measurable improvements in productivity, quality, and cost reduction.
* Certified Six Sigma Black Belt (CSSBB).
* Multi-Site Manufacturing experience
