protected_roles.description:
Global Director, Operational Excellence COE
  
  
At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future.
  
  
We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you?
  
  
**About the job**
The Global Director, Operational Excellence (OpEx) COE is a senior leadership role responsible for defining the strategic direction, standards, and governance of Nouryon’s global OpEx program. This role owns the organizational design, frameworks, methodologies, and capability pipelines that enable sustainable continuous improvement across 63 manufacturing sites in the Integrated Supply Chain (ISC) organization – spanning the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
  
  
This role is the architect of OpEx productivity engine. The COE Director owns the design of the systems, standards, and organizational capabilities that enable VMC and FMC delivery – including ownership of the enterprise systems of record for productivity tracking (ANT) and performance reporting (PowerBI). Execution of productivity targets is driven through the regional OpEx Manager network; this role ensures those teams are equipped, aligned, and operating within a governance structure capable of sustaining results.
  
  
This role leads a newly consolidated Center of Excellence that brings together CI methodology and Lean/Six Sigma certification, ISC Learning & Development, End-to-End Process Management, and Manufacturing Excellence under a single governance structure. The COE Director sets priorities, establishes the program architecture, and holds accountability for outcomes – operating through a team of direct reports who own execution across regions. Key relationships span the COO, regional OpEx Managers, Site Directors, and ISC functional leaders across three regions.
  
  
This is a permanent, full-time position reporting to the VP, Global Operational Excellence & Digital Manufacturing, based in a Nouryon regional hub (Amsterdam, Houston, or Shanghai) with global travel of 15–25%.
  
  
**In your future role as the Global Director, Operational Excellence COE, you will**
**CI Methodology, Standards & Governance**

* Own the global Operational Excellence methodology, ensuring a consistent, fit-for-purpose CI framework is deployed across all 63 Nouryon manufacturing sites.

* Define and govern the Lean/Six Sigma certification pathway from Yellow Belt through Master Black Belt, establishing quality standards for program content, assessment, and progression.
* Partner with regional OpEx Managers to translate global standards into site-level execution plans, maintaining strategic alignment while enabling regional adaptation.
* Establish and sustain a durable CI Governance model – defining the review cadence, accountability structure, and performance mechanisms that ensure CI maturity compounds over time across the Nouryon network.
* Own the enterprise systems of record for productivity tracking and performance reporting, including the ANT productivity platform and PowerBI reporting architecture, ensuring data integrity and leadership visibility across all sites.

**ISC Learning & Development**

* Lead the design and continuous improvement of the ISC Learning & Development program, spanning CI capability, technical skills, and leadership development for the ISC organization.
* Direct the L&D team to build and maintain a structured curriculum that supports onboarding, role progression, and organizational capability uplift.
* Connect L&D investment directly to VMC and FMC delivery targets, ensuring program outcomes are measurable and business-relevant.
* Own the design mandate for Digital Literacy and AI capability across the ISC organization – defining the people, process, and metrics framework required to build and sustain enterprise AI competency at scale. This includes establishing program objectives, identifying ownership, and proposing a deployment model aligned to Nouryon’s broader digital strategy.

**End-to-End Process Management**

* Own the ISC End-to-End process architecture, defining process standards, documentation requirements, and governance for core ISC value streams.
* Drive process modeling and SIPOC-level design across ISC, working through the Process Modeler and Global Process Owner to ensure clarity of accountability and performance standards.
* Identify and close process design gaps that create risk, inefficiency, or measurement inconsistency across the ISC organization.

**Manufacturing Excellence**

* Define the Manufacturing Excellence framework for Nouryon, including OEE, TPM, reliability, and asset performance standards applied across the manufacturing network.
* Direct the Manufacturing Excellence Manager to develop and deploy site-level improvement programs, closing the loop between plant performance data and structured intervention.
* Integrate manufacturing excellence priorities into the broader OpEx roadmap, ensuring alignment with Digital Manufacturing, Palantir-enabled analytics, and capital investment decisions.

**People Leadership & COE Development**

* Lead a geographically distributed team of nine direct reports
* Define team structure, role clarity, and succession priorities for the COE
* Build a high-performance COE culture grounded in Nouryon’s Leadership Capability Framework

This role requires approximately 15–25% global travel across the Americas, Europe, and Asia Pacific.
  
  
**Key Performance Indicators**
The Global Director, Operational Excellence COE is measured against the same Breakthrough KPIs as the VP, Global Operational Excellence & Digital Manufacturing. This alignment is intentional – the COE’s organizational design, capability systems, and governance structures exist to enable these outcomes. Execution is driven through the regional OpEx Manager network; this role is accountable for building and sustaining the organization capable of delivering them.
  

* People Safety
* Process Safety
* FMC — Fixed Manufacturing Cost Productivity
* VMC — Variable Manufacturing Cost Productivity
* OEE — Overall Equipment Effectiveness
* OTIF — On-Time In-Full
* Quality Sigma Level
* CI Activation Rate

**We believe you bring**

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Operations, Business, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
* A minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in Operational Excellence, Continuous Improvement, or manufacturing leadership roles in a global, multi-site environment.
* Certified Master Black Belt (MBB) or Black Belt in Lean/Six Sigma, with demonstrated capability to design, govern, and quality-assure a full belt certification program.
* Proven track record of leading change management initiatives in large, matrixed, multi-regional organizations – with the ability to align diverse stakeholders and shift organizational culture.
* Deep knowledge of Manufacturing Excellence frameworks including OEE, TPM, and reliability methodologies, with experience deploying these at scale across a manufacturing network.
* Demonstrated people leadership across multiple geographies and organizational grades, including experience developing high-performing teams in a distributed structure.

**Great if you have**

* Experience in specialty chemicals, process manufacturing, or a similarly regulated, capital-intensive industrial environment.
* Hands-on expertise in End-to-End process design and governance, including SIPOC-level architecture and process ownership models.
* Experience designing and leading corporate Learning & Development programs, including competency frameworks and structured curricula for technical disciplines.
* Prior experience building or structuring a Center of Excellence from the ground up, including team design, governance models, and stakeholder alignment.
* Working proficiency with PowerBI or equivalent reporting platforms for program performance tracking and executive communication.

**We believe you are**
...
  
  
A systems thinker who sees the whole before diving into the parts. You lead through frameworks, not firefighting – you understand that durable operational excellence is built on governance, capability, and culture, not individual heroics. You bring intellectual rigor to every conversation and are comfortable challenging assumptions at any level of the organization, including in rooms where the answer is already assumed.
  
  
You are energized by building – building teams, building programs, building the conditions for others to succeed. You know how to hold standards without being rigid, and how to drive urgency without creating chaos. The right candidate is someone who finds genuine satisfaction in watching a global organization improve because of the systems they put in place – and who brings the patience, persistence, and precision that transformation at scale demands.
  
  
**We offer you**
This is a rare opportunity to architect and lead a newly consolidated global COE with a clear mandate from senior leadership, a defined team, and direct line of sight to enterprise value delivery. You will operate with significant autonomy, build the structure you believe is right, and leave a measurable legacy across a global manufacturing organization at an inflection point in its CI and digital transformation journey.
  
  
At Nouryon, we provide a great job and friendly coworkers, plus benefits in addition to salary.
  
  
**Have we got your interest?**
This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to VP, Global Operational Excellence & Digital Manufacturing, based in a Nouryon regional hub Amsterdam, Netherlands | Houston, TX, USA
  
  
Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application!
  
  
We kindly ask our internal candidates to apply with your Nouryon email via Success Factors.
  
  
**About Nouryon**
Explore careers and life at Nouryon
  
  
If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment.
  
  
Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn .
  
  
**#WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs**
We have already chosen our sourcing channels for this recruitment and kindly ask not to be contacted by any advertisement agents, recruitment agencies or staffing companies.
  
  
  
  
Nouryon is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

protected_roles.title: Head of Quality
protected_roles.description:
**About Tutor**
---------------

We believe robots are the biggest lever we have to making the physical world a better, more affordable place. But robots are a rounding error in our society: nearly nine out of ten American factories and warehouses don’t even have a single robot, and robots have yet to make their way into our homes or places of business.

Tutor Intelligence is changing that.

Tutor is a robotics research and deployment company, building generally capable robot hardware and artificial intelligence to enable robots to go where no robots have gone before. Sonny is a semi-humanoid robot with frontier dexterity approaching the human form. Cassie does back-breaking work, moving boxes, pallets, and bulk goods for businesses from family-owned manufacturers to some of the largest brands in the world. Tutor robots are manufactured at scale and operate as a network, combining the whole fleet’s learned experience to train ever more capable robot artificial intelligence.

Founded at MIT and headquartered in Watertown, MA, our team is full stack: we design and manufacture robot hardware, train our own models, work directly with the smallest and largest end-customers, and maintain our fleet across the United States. We’re a team of researchers, engineers, technicians, operators, and sellers who love building things and solving hard problems.

Our mission is grand: robots everywhere, for the common good, raising the standard of living across North America, and then the world.

**The Role**
------------

As Head of Quality, you’ll lead quality as a function, alongside the Head of Manufacturing. The quality engineers and the quality manager report to you, and you’ll grow the team from there. This is a building role: incoming inspection, supplier controls and failure analysis are being put in place now, and you’ll turn them into a system that holds as production grows.

You’ll report to the CTO. As our operations organization grows, you’ll report to its leader. This is an onsite role in Watertown, MA.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* The quality system, and the quality targets the company holds itself to
* Supplier quality across our supply base
* Product safety certifications, and a quality record customers and certifying bodies can verify
* The authority to hold any shipment that isn’t right
* Growing the quality team

**Requirements**
----------------

* Led a quality function at a company that builds complex electromechanical hardware in volume
* Built or rebuilt a quality system and taken it through ISO 9001 or an equivalent certification
* Ran supplier quality across a supply base, including overseas suppliers
* Taken a product through product safety certification
* Built and led a team of quality engineers and managers
* Make decisions from data, and hold a shipment when the data says so

**Nice to have:**

* Robotics, automation, vehicles or capital equipment
* Reliability engineering methods: life testing, failure rate analysis, design reviews
* Building quality data and tooling that other teams use
* Experience with manufacturing execution systems

**What to Expect**
------------------

We want you to know exactly what to expect. Here’s what our interview process typically looks like:

* **Recruiter interview:** A conversation with a member of our Recruiting team about your background and what you’re looking for.
* **Hiring manager interview:** A deeper conversation with the hiring manager about the role and your experience.
* **Onsite:** A presentation with the team, 1:1s with key team members, and a tour of our facility.

Some roles include additional steps, such as a technical assessment or take-home exercise. If yours does, we’ll let you know up front. Throughout the process, we’ll aim to keep you updated at each step as quickly as possible.

**Why Tutor?**
--------------

Whether you’re designing robots, closing deals, running deployments, or creating the processes that help us scale, your work doesn’t sit on a shelf. It shows up on real production floors, making physical work safer and more affordable.

Our team of 160+ is driven by curiosity and a genuine love of building. Everyone here takes real ownership, learns fast, and holds a high bar while having each other’s backs. If you love hard problems and creating things that didn’t exist before, you’ll fit right in.

**Benefits**
------------

We take care of our team so they can do their best work. At Tutor, you’ll get:

* Fully employer-covered health insurance, so you’re protected without the premium.
* A managed 401(k) to help you plan for the future.
* Generous time off: unlimited PTO and all federal holidays off for full-time salaried employees, and 16+ days of accrued paid time off plus 1.5x pay on federal holidays for hourly employees.
* Regular in-office meals and team social events throughout the year.

As Tutor grows, so will our benefits. We’re continuing to invest in ways to support our team at work and beyond.

Tutor Intelligence is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

Compensation Range: $220K - $280K

* Collaborate with the Chief Medical Officer and Health Equity Officer to establish organizational quality and health equity goals, priorities, and strategies.

* Develop, review, and maintain quality management plans, policies, procedures, annual evaluations, and supporting documentation.
* Monitor project timelines, implementation activities, risks, and barriers to successful program execution.
* Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and performance management for assigned staff.
* Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement, accountability, innovation, and health equity.

**You may be right for this job if you have the following:**

* Five (5) years of experience in managed care, healthcare quality, utilization management, care management, population health, compliance, clinical operations, or related healthcare programs.
* Two (2) or more years of program, project, or operational leadership experience supporting quality, regulatory, performance improvement, or healthcare initiatives.
* Three (3) years of progressive leadership, management, or supervisory experience.
* Experience leading quality improvement, clinical operations, regulatory compliance, accreditation, or performance improvement initiatives.
* Experience managing cross-functional projects and organizational initiatives.
* Experience collaborating with physicians, healthcare providers, executive leadership, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Experience developing policies, procedures, reports, presentations, and organizational work plans.
* Experience working within a managed care or healthcare delivery environment.
* Experience analyzing quality, clinical, operational, or regulatory performance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Knowledge of healthcare quality programs, accreditation standards, and regulatory requirements, including CMS, DHCS, DMHC, and NCQA.
* Experience developing and implementing policies, procedures, corrective action plans, quality initiatives, and operational improvement strategies.
* Strong project management, analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with physicians, executive leadership, providers, health equity leaders, and multidisciplinary teams.
* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex concepts to diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

**Our commitment to you:**

* A competitive salary of $130,000-$160,000/ year
* Health, dental and vision insurance for you and your family covered 85%
* Generous paid time off
* A retirement plan with a generous match
* A chance to make a real difference in the Imperial Valley community

Preference will be given to candidates who are local to Imperial, California, but remote candidates living in California will also be considered.

We are an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Production activities and coordinates projects. Maintains quality control and ensures the project is going smoothly and according to schedule.

**Essentials Functions**

* Full and complete working knowledge and understanding of all equipment.
* Promotes and supports safety culture and ensures compliance with safety rules and regulations.
* Manages the plant’s production function while maintaining working relationships with other departments to ensure smooth operation.
* Reviews sales forecast and schedules production to ascertain and meet production quantity and quality requirements.
* Review production and operating reports, and resolve operational, manufacturing, and maintenance problems to ensure safety, while minimizing costs and preventing operational delays.
* Complies, stores, and retrieves production data. Monitors physical inventory levels.
* Oversee employee training requirements.
* Additional major functions include planning, annual budgeting and monthly forecasting, reporting of department’s effectiveness, safeguarding assets, and environmental compliance.
* This position requires knowledge equivalent to that which normally would be acquired through a bachelor’s degree in mechanical, industrial, or chemical engineering, or related field.
* Ability to analyze, troubleshoot, critically think about, and resolve problems with field equipment.
* Make sure all equipment is mechanically sound, safe, and ready to work daily.
* Oversee the daily construction activities at work site, including scheduling of workers, delivery of equipment and materials and progress of the project.
* Professionally and positively motivate and direct activities of the crew to enable the completion of work in a safe environmentally responsible and timely manner.
* Daily pre-job preparation and organization for self and crew members, including safety meetings.
* Complete and turn in all paperwork and log in a professional, legible, and timely manner.
* Manage aggregate production to ensure goals and objectives are met.
* Responsible for maintenance and repair of all mobile and stationary equipment.
* Ensures that the workforce complies with policies, procedures, and regulations to produce a productive labor climate at plant facilities.
* Assist Plant Managers and Quality Control Departments as necessary to ensure quality products, accounts & service.
* Assist in development of riverbed aggregate sites, pit operations and reclamation.
* Equipment repair and preventative maintenance
* Interact with vendors and employees.
* Maintain a high degree of customers satisfaction and employee morale through problem solving.
* Ensure a safe working environment through daily inspections and monthly safety meetings.
* Supervise 1-2 aggregate plants (both fixed and mobile)

**Qualifications**

* High School diploma or equivalent
* A minimum of 5 years’ experience in the operations of a sand and gravel pit.
* Experience in a supervisory capacity
* Knowledge of MSHA rules and regulations
* Experience in planning, design, and project management
* Minimum of two years of operating experience
* Ability to understand and follow instructions.
* Ability to learn the methods and practices used in our business.
* Ability to perform strenuous work in varying weather conditions.
* Knowledge of heavy equipment including but not limited to loaders, dozers, and hydraulic excavators and off-road haul trucks. Plant processing includes, but is not limited to water pumps, generators, electrical control components, vibratory screens, sand screws, conveyors, radial stackers, material washers, scales, settling basins, vibratory feeders, and log washers.
* Ability to meet deadlines and multi-task.

**Physical Demands & Work Environment**

Must be able to walk on uneven terrain, climb stairs and ladders, occasionally lift up to 50 pounds, wear required PPE, and work extended hours as needed. Valid driver's license and ability to safely conduct site inspections required.

**NOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES**

* Ability to understand and follow instructions.
* Ability to learn the methods and practices used in the Pits.
* Ability to perform strenuous work in varying weather conditions.

protected_roles.title: Regional Director of Operations
protected_roles.description:
At El Pollo Loco, we are on a mission to be the nation’s leading fire-grilled chicken restaurant. When it comes to our people, we are all about growth. Whether that means specialized training, a clearly laid out career trajectory or collaborating cross-functionally, we are committed to the success of our people the same way we’ve been committed to the success of the El Pollo Loco brand for the last 50 years. In fact, we see you as our secret ingredient. While our chicken is fire, it’s our people who set us ablaze.
  
  
Our restaurants are only the tip of the flame! If you’re looking for an innovative, winning, and welcoming workplace, then a flamin’ good career in our Restaurant Support Center is right for you.
  
  
At our Support Center, we believe our best work is done Together, when departments collaborate and everyone is confident in contributing their ideas. This is why we are in the office 3 days per week.
  
  
Let’s Get Loco!
  
  
What’s in it for you!
  
  

* STRONG office culture recognized as a Great Place to Work® and driven by our core values: Simple. Together. Relentless. Ownership. Nimble. Growth
* Career growth opportunities
* Competitive pay and bonus potential
* Be an Owner: Equity Compensation
* Medical + Dental + Vision Insurance + HSA Savings Account
* 401(K) Retirement Plan with company match and immediate vesting
* Paid Vacation + Sick Pay + 12 Paid Holidays
* Employee Assistance Program
* Free El Pollo Loco food + restaurant discounts
* PerkSpot discounts program

**POSITION PURPOSE:**  
The Regional Director of Operations is responsible for driving El Pollo Loco’s success in the Los Angeles, CA region. They are responsible for providing operational expertise, strategic leadership and coaching. Directs, leads, manages and analyzes all aspects of the restaurant operations for the Areas under their direction to ensure achievement and maintenance of the regional sales, budgetary targets, controllable profit, performance metrics (e.g., service, quality, cleanliness, etc.), brand integrity, and compliance standards (e.g., food and restaurant safety, federal/state/local labor laws, etc.). Implements and executes strategic and tactical operational initiatives that support future business growth strategies. Oversees and manages adequate resource availability for existing and new restaurant openings including the attraction, retention, training, development and coaching of a high performing management team.
  
  
**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

* Oversees all aspects of the region’s restaurant business, operations, and facilities. Directs and aligns company strategies with restaurant management activities.
* Utilizes reporting systems to determine trends in sales, cost of goods and guest services. Reviews, monitors and manages the financial progress of the individual restaurants and region, including food and labor costs, ensuring budgeted targets are achieved.
* Meets regularly with Area Leaders to coach, develop, train and review performance, share best practices and disseminate information on any areas where there is an opportunity for improvement (e.g., P&L, RCP, FSA, QSC, Mystery Shops, etc.). Develops action plans with Area Leaders to improve revenue, profitability and quality/service standards.
* Directs, manages and ensures the region’s successful and timely implementation of all marketing strategies and LTOs. Supports and inspects marketing strategies in building guest counts and sales.
* Provides effective and timely resolution to all guest and employee complaints, conflicts and employee relations that cannot be resolved at the Area Leader level.
* Ensures the region’s restaurants are in compliance with all local, regional, and national laws and have all the required documentation and paperwork.
* Leverages two-way communication with Field and Support Center employees. Represents the Operations perspective on prioritization, planning and promotions to inspire operational excellence, effective implementation and facilitate insights. Provides specific operational input and feedback into the development of new products and programs to ensure successful execution.
* Collaborates with Development, Human Resources, and Operations in the coordination and execution of new restaurant openings. Directs team selection, monitors the training and ensures the teams perform to El Pollo Loco’s standards. Participates in the local public relations support in all locations. Approves employee relocation within region ensuring moves are conducted in the most economical and efficient manner.
* Develops regional succession plans: evaluates open opportunities, assesses internal talent, oversees management training programs, and drives recruiting efforts to ensure adequate number of managers are available to sustain growth of the organization.
* Champions effective vertical and horizontal communications within the regional area including Company-wide news of interest, upcoming events, new facilities, promotions, product developments, “Best Practices” among peers, etc. Prepares thoroughly and delivers well-organized, dynamic and informative presentations to senior management as needed. Holds meetings with their respective teams on a regular basis to ensure fluid and consistent messaging.
* Creates and fosters a positive team environment through recognizing and reinforcing behaviors and results that are aligned with El Pollo Loco’s core values and culture. Ensures open channels for employee suggestions.
* Interacts professionally and ethically, constructively participating as a collaborative team leader in pursuit of common goals, including active attendance to meetings. Initiates cost-effective suggestions to improve operational procedures.
* Other activities, duties or responsibilities that are assigned by your supervisor.

QUALIFICATIONS – EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE, LICENSE/CERTIFICATIONS:
  
To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job. The requirements listed below are representative of the education and/or experience required.
  
  
**Education/Work Experience:**  
High school diploma or equivalent (GED) required, BA/BS degree in Business Administration preferred. 8+ years QSR/multi-site restaurant experience as an Area Leader or District Manager required; 5+ years regional QSR management experience preferred; 3+ years El Pollo Loco experience preferred; and a track record of success in leading, managing, coaching and developing high performance teams.
  
  
**License/Certifications:**  
Current valid driver’s license required as frequent weekly travel is involved. Current ServSafe certification preferred.
  
  
**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**  

* Experience with successfully recruiting, building, and developing a team (based on current and future needs).
* Confidence in execution of strategic initiatives.
* Must be decisive and able to make fact-based decisions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset and skills; meticulous attention to detail
* Ability to effectively communicate with internal and external business partners.
* Ability to prioritize and plan work assignments and work under pressure of frequent and tight deadlines.
* Ability to read, write, and interpret complex reports, documents, and correspondence.
* Adept at managing and prioritizing competing time sensitive requests while working well in a team atmosphere that may be under pressure.
* Ability to exercise independent judgment on matters of significance to the company.
* Ability to work weekends and extended work schedules as needed.
* Must be willing and able to travel locally within Southern California and to out-of-state restaurant locations, as needed by car or airplane.

Our Company
  
  
In 1980 the first American El Pollo Loco opened on Alvarado Street in Los Angeles, quickly becoming a destination for the best citrus-marinated, fire-grilled pollo in town. Over the past four decades, El Pollo Loco has grown into more than 500 restaurants across 9 states, becoming an L.A. mainstay and cultural benchmark along the way. And today, we continue to work just as hard to always provide customers with fresh and innovative L.A. Mex from our famous family dinners to Mexican entrees.
  
  
The pay range identified is the hourly or salary rate El Pollo Loco expects to pay for the posted position. This range does not include any benefits or bonus opportunities that might be available for the position based on position and eligibility criteria. Individual pay will vary based on a variety of factors including years of experience, industry experience, education, geography, etc.

protected_roles.description:
**Director of Operations – DC Restaurant Group**
================================================

**DC Restaurant Group | Richmond VA Area**

**Salary: $150,000–$175,000 Annually**

### **About the Opportunity**

DC Restaurant Group is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Director of Operations** to oversee daily operations across a large restaurant group with multiple locations throughout Virginia and North Carolina.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strong restaurant operations leader who is passionate about developing teams, improving restaurant performance, and driving operational excellence across multiple markets.

The Director of Operations will report directly to the Vice President of Operations and work closely with District Managers to ensure restaurants are operating efficiently, meeting company standards, and achieving financial and operational goals.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee daily operations across a large portfolio of restaurant locations, ensuring consistency and strong operational performance.
* Lead, coach, and develop District Managers to drive accountability, leadership development, and restaurant success.
* Partner with the Vice President of Operations to execute company strategies, initiatives, and operational goals.
* Monitor restaurant performance, including sales, profitability, labor costs, food costs, and overall P&L results.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits to evaluate operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and support District Managers.
* Ensure restaurants consistently meet company standards for food safety, cleanliness, customer service, and operational efficiency.
* Develop action plans to address performance challenges and improve restaurant results.
* Support recruitment, training, and development of restaurant leadership teams.
* Work closely with District Managers to improve employee retention, guest satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Provide regular updates to the Vice President of Operations regarding market performance, operational challenges, and opportunities for growth.

### **Qualifications**

* 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in multi-unit restaurant operations.
* Previous experience as a Director of Operations, Regional Director, or senior multi-unit restaurant leader.
* Strong background in quick-service restaurants (QSR), preferably within a franchise or large multi-unit restaurant organization.
* Proven experience leading and developing District Managers across multiple restaurant locations.
* Strong understanding of restaurant financials, P&L management, budgeting, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability, operational standards, and team performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Virginia and North Carolina to support restaurant operations.

### **Compensation**

**$150,000–$175,000 annually**, depending on experience.

**Apply today to join DC Restaurant Group and play a key role in the continued growth and success of our restaurant organization!**

DC Restaurant Group is the corporate headquarters supporting four restaurant brands: Anthony’s Coal Fired Pizza, Burger King (DC Burger), Round Table Pizza, and Buffalo Wild Wings (West Coast Wings).  
Located in Arlington, VA, our corporate office provides support across multiple departments, including Human Resources, Finance, Operations, Facilities, and more. We are continuing to grow our corporate team and are looking for talented individuals to help support our restaurants across multiple states.

Pay: $150000.00 - $175000.00 / year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Dental insurance
* Vision insurance
* Paid time off

Job Type: fulltime

Education: No education required

Work location: On-site

Arlington. 3030 Clarendon Blvd, Arlington, VA, 22201

protected_roles.title: Director of Operational Excellence
protected_roles.description:
Job Summary - Why you’ll love this position

Are you motivated by the challenge of solving complex, enterprise-wide problems? Do you love asking "why" and transforming good operations into exceptional public experiences? If so, consider joining the State of Missouri as our next Director of Operational Excellence!

In this pivotal leadership role you will champion continuous improvement across state government, lead our operational initiatives, and oversee our statewide customer experience program. This position resides within the Office of Administration, the administrative arm of the executive branch, but leads efforts that span all executive agencies to improve service delivery to the citizens of Missouri.

We are seeking an energetic, visionary executive to lead and empower a dedicated team of process improvement and customer experience efforts while serving as a strategic partner to executive leadership, agency partners, and frontline public servants. Our next director is a bridge-builder who combines proven improvement methodologies with human-centered design, modern customer experience principles, rapid responsiveness to agency partner needs, and a passion for coaching state team members to achieve measurable public outcomes.

In addition to the inspiring work that will improve the services provided by state government and your colleagues work environment, you will receive a great benefits package that includes paid time off, medical/vision/dental insurance, life insurance, and retirement.

*The salary indicated represents a base pay rate. If the individual selected or the position is eligible for a pay differential (e.g., shift, security, or years of service), it will be added to the total compensation in your paycheck. A pay differential does not raise your base pay.*

Responsibilities - What you’ll do

* Work collaboratively with leadership and teams to encourage, develop, and execute strategies to create a culture of continuous improvement across Missouri state government. Measure the effectiveness of improvements and provide administration with visibility to such improvements.
* Act as a subject matter expert and promote change management by sharing Lean Six Sigma and other Operational Excellence best practices. Teach, mentor, coach and lead Operational Excellence leaders from every state department.
* Continuously provide helpful operational excellence resources for team members and facilitate training sessions.
* Model excellence in leadership and act with urgency to achieve results and lead efforts to cultivate a culture of data-based decision making.
* Facilitate, lead, and oversee state level strategic initiatives and other projects as assigned by leadership.
* Coordinate and host an annual Show Me Excellence Summit and represent the State of Missouri at national operational excellence events.

Qualifications - All you need for success

**Minimum Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Formal training in Lean Six Sigma or an equivalent continuous process improvement framework. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification is strongly preferred
* Demonstrated advanced knowledge in Lean and Operational Excellence frameworks and facilitation methodologies
* Hands-on experience work with survey, feedback, or data visualization platforms, such as Qualtrics, Tableau, or Power BI

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Must be action oriented, demonstrate superior organizational abilities and have strong facilitation skills and excellent communications skills.
* Ability to work with leaders and multi-level teams to establish goals, performance indicators, actions plans and deliverables and effectively communicating across broad audiences.
* Must have excellent leadership abilities. This individual must be an effective collaborator with energy, enthusiasm and a can-do attitude who can empower others, gain buy-in and achieve results.
* Good understanding of data analysis related to process improvement and an ability to analyze data to gain insights and support problem solving.
* Training, certification, and/or education in continuous process improvement programs such as Lean Six Sigma as well as completion of Missouri Way, Leadership Academy, and similar programs is preferred.

***Lack of post******‐******secondary education will not be used as the sole basis denying consideration to any applicant.***

Successful background check results are required for employment in this position. This may include background checks involving a candidate's name and/or fingerprints and other screenings as needed for the specific position.

Authorization to work in the United States is a prerequisite of employment. The Office of Administration will not sponsor applicants for work visas.

Job Details - More reasons to love this position

The State of Missouri offers an excellent benefits package that includes a defined pension plan, generous amounts of leave and holiday time, and eligibility for health insurance coverage. Your total compensation is more than the dollars you receive in your paycheck. To help demonstrate the value of working for the State of Missouri, we have created an interactive Total Compensation Calculator. This tool provides a comprehensive view of benefits and more that are offered to prospective employees. The Total Compensation Calculator and other applicant resources can be found here.

Contact Details - If you have questions or require any accommodations to participate in the application or interview process please contact:

OARecruiters@oa.mo.gov

The State of Missouri is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to developing and maintaining a talented workforce.
